descriptions.zh:
虚境回响着前所未有的残暴。巨大的能量弧在以太中翻滚不息。

在狂乱闪烁的混沌中，我们看到了合成女王的灵能回声。她无边无际、无所不能，将整个星系玩弄于股掌之间。

并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，§H抟土之塑师§!也悄然俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。

怎会如此？难道祂知道什么我们不知道的弱点吗？如果我们向祂伸出援手，它会帮我们吗？

把注意力集中在塑师身上时，我们感受到祂的不耐烦。我们很可能只有一次机会就这个问题向祂求助。为此我们可能需要非常大量的§H能量币§!和§H泽珞§!。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud reverberates with an unprecedented ferocity. Vast coils of energy writhe and thrash in the ether.

Amid the strobing disorder, we behold the psionic echoes of the synthetic queen. Infinite and omnipotent, she toys with the galaxy in her palm.

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, the §HAnimator of Clay§! watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

Why? Does it know of a weakness we do not? Will it assist us if we reach out to it?

As we focus our minds upon the Animator, we sense its impatience. It is very likely that we will only have one opportunity to ask for its aid in this matter. Massive quantities of §HEnergy§! and §HZro§! will be needed for the effort.

label.en: §LReach out to the Animator of Clay.§!
We do not need its help.

tooltips.zh: 我们不会再有请求塑师帮忙击败塞塔娜的机会。
tooltips.en: We will never get another chance to request the Animator's help in defeating Cetana.

descriptions.zh: 在接管§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等灵能光环的机械装置。
descriptions.en: In taking control of the §H[from.GetName]§! system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

descriptions.zh: 我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。
descriptions.en: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was once thought to be fringe science.

tooltips.zh: 获得随机科技的洞见：§G$@good_luck_event_1_insight|0%$§!
tooltips.en: Insight gained on a random technology: §G$@good_luck_event_1_insight|0%$§!

descriptions.zh:
§H[mining_planet.GetName]§!上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。

经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。
descriptions.en:
A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!.

After a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitation with the expansion of existing mining efforts.

descriptions.zh:
§H[mining_planet.GetName]§!上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。

经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。

descriptions.zh: 一艘渔船在§H[This.GetName]§!的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
descriptions.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of §H[This.GetName]§!. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

descriptions.zh:
在例行土地探察时意外地发现了§H[This.GetName]§!上大片土地的土壤质量近年来急剧提高。

我们相信许多此前认为不适合耕种的土地现在可以用来扩张农业活动了。
descriptions.en:
A routine land survey has revealed that the soil quality on §H[This.GetName]§! has drastically improved in recent years across large swathes of the planet.

We believe that many areas once thought incapable of supporting agriculture can now be used to expand our farming efforts.

descriptions.zh:
在一场§H[This.GetName]§!上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。

该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。
descriptions.en:
Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on §H[This.GetName]§!. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.

This natural phenomenon provides us with an opportunity to expand the colony's energy infrastructure with new geothermal power plants and heat pumps.

descriptions.zh:
一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在§H[physics_planet.GetName]§!附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。

对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。
descriptions.en:
An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near §H[physics_planet.GetName]§!. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.

Focused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[From.GetResearchers]在§H[society_planet.GetName]§!系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。

初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。

如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。
descriptions.en:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near §H[society_planet.GetName]§!.

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages relate to logical principles and philosophical quandaries. Perhaps this is an attempt at intellectual enrichment from entities beyond our comprehension.

If we establish a direct feed with these signals we can continue to monitor their revelations.

descriptions.zh:
§H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
descriptions.en:
A derelict ship has appeared in §H[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]§!. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

We have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctioned. No life signs are onboard, and we have already begun careful disassembly of the vessel to learn as much as we can.

descriptions.zh:
§H[mining_planet.GetName]§!的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。

该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。
descriptions.en:
Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of §H[mining_planet.GetName]§!. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.

This geological phenomenon has superheated some of the unexploited minerals, refining veins of metallic ore into solid alloys. As such, mining operations on the planet will now produce fragments of workable metal.

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.zh:
在§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。

在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
descriptions.en:
A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the §H[From.GetName]§! system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.

After an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEngineerPlural] have declared that the ship is now fit for active service.

tooltips.zh: 在该恒星系内获得一艘巡洋舰级舰船。
tooltips.en: Gain a cruiser class ship in the system.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
descriptions.en: The §H[This.GetName]§! is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

descriptions.zh: 一种难以言喻的乐观主义席卷了[This.GetAdjective]各星。大众们对自己的生活感到更加满足、舒适和惬意。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象吉兆引起，而且对§H[This.GetName]§!而言必须是一个好兆头。
descriptions.en: An inexplicable air of optimism is washing throughout [This.GetAdjective] worlds. The population is that bit more content, comfortable, and satisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments, and can only be a good omen for the future of the §H[This.GetName]§!.

label.en: The stars shine brightly upon us.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的三个天体排列成了完美的三位一体构型；即§H[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]§!、§H[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]§!和§H[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]§!。

这种有利天象为我们在§H[This.GetName]§!的殖民地带来了宁静与和谐。
descriptions.en:
Three celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a favorable trine; §H[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]§! and §H[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]§!.

This beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of tranquility and harmony to our colony on §H[This.GetName]§!.

label.en: A once in a lifetime event.

descriptions.zh:
§H[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]§!在§H[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!的夜空中升上吉位，入主天回星宫。

该天象代表[root.GetName]内在循环的新开端，是增长和发展的重大机遇。
descriptions.en:
§H[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]§! is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above §H[root.capital_scope.GetName]§!, residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.

This represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] and a prime opportunity for growth and improvement.

descriptions.zh:
所有定量占星矩阵都表明[This.GetName]目前处于完美的元素平衡。

利用精确的能量线管理可以将这种有益平衡维持很长时间，为我们领袖的繁盛提供理想的形而上环境。
descriptions.en:
All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.

With precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which our leaders can flourish.

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强§H[This.GetName]§!上各种各样的发电活动。
descriptions.en: The primary luminary in the §H[From.GetName]§! system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on §H[This.GetName]§!.

label.en: May the stars shine brightly upon us.

descriptions.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，§H[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]§!和§H[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]§!发现他们的占星结果高度互补。

因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。
descriptions.en:
Two of our council members, §H[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]§! recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.

Their subsequent political partnership has since united our government under a banner of mutual respect and efficiency, accelerating various legislative processes.

descriptions.zh:
在一次例行编目中，一个没固定好的的标本掉在了§H博物天枢§!的地上，随后被及时送到保管员那里进行进一步检查。

因为这场事故我们意外得发现，该标本中的一个秘密隔间松动了。里面藏着各种各样的有趣的文物可以丰富我们的馆藏，而此事之前完全未被注意到。
descriptions.en:
During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the §HGrand Archive§! and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.

Surprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Previously unnoticed, it contained a wide variety of interesting artifacts we can add to our collection.

descriptions.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着§H[This.GetName]§!。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
descriptions.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the §H[This.GetName]§!. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

descriptions.zh: 在我们的各个星球上，一种难以言喻的恐惧笼罩着所有人。人们对自己的生活感到愈发苦恼、烦躁和不满。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象凶兆引起的。
descriptions.en: There is an inexplicable sense of looming dread throughout the population on our worlds. The people are feeling more distressed, distracted, and dissatisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

descriptions.zh:
在位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致§H[This.GetName]§!的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。
descriptions.en:
A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the §H[This.GetName]§! in §H[This.System.GetName]§!.

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible for this error have been disciplined appropriately.

tooltips.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!损失舰船数：§R5§!
tooltips.en: Ships destroyed in §H[This.GetName]§!: §R5§!

descriptions.zh:
§H[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]§!上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
descriptions.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on §H[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]§! resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

descriptions.zh:
§H[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]§!中[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation]的恒星基地上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
descriptions.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on the [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation] of §H[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]§! resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

descriptions.zh: 灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
descriptions.en: The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

资源损失：§R$@silo_fire_resources_lost|1%$§!
tooltips.en:

descriptions.zh:
一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。

虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。
descriptions.en:
One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vitriolic and hateful insults to the [diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]. The unfortunate incident has been spread across the galactic media and disparaged our reputation.

While these actions do not warrant immediate dismissal, our standing within the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has been weakened as a result of this indiscretion.

tooltips.zh: §H[diplomatic_faux_pas_galcom_envoy.GetName]§!获得了新特质：§R设备杀手§!
tooltips.en: §H[diplomatic_faux_pas_galcom_envoy.GetName]§! gained a new trait: §RDestructive§!

descriptions.zh:
§H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§!发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。

这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
descriptions.en:
An unprecedented solar flare from §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§! has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.

This aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial body. Our analysis of the star's coronal layer shows that its predicted lifespan has been reduced by over three million years.

descriptions.zh: 释放出的能量还在该恒星系中引发了一场星尘风暴。目前已经采取紧急应对措施。
descriptions.en: The resulting discharge of energy has triggered a Stardust Storm in the system. Emergency measures are currently underway.

tooltips.zh: §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§!内所有的观测站、研究站以及开采站都被摧毁了。
tooltips.en: Every Observation Post, Research Station and Mining Station in §H[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed.

descriptions.zh:
意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在§H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass]§H[This.GetName]§!。

不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。
descriptions.en:
Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.

Unfortunately, their systems were damaged beyond repair.

descriptions.zh:
意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在§H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass]§H[This.GetName]§!。

尽管我们的应急措施响应及时，[This.GetHisHer]的伤还是太重了，不治身亡。
descriptions.en:
Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.

Despite the swift response of our emergency services, [This.GetHisHer] injuries ultimately proved fatal.

descriptions.zh: 意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在§H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass]§H[This.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在§H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass]§H[This.GetName]§!。

[This.GetName]虽然得以幸存，但也受了不可逆损伤。
descriptions.en:
Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on §H[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] §H[This.GetName]§!.

[This.GetName] survived the collision, but not unscathed. The damage done is irreversible.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.GetName]§!地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。

我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。
descriptions.en:
Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected areas were evacuated successfully.

We cannot determine the exact cause of the sudden appearance of these geological cavities, but additional maintenance checks have been implemented to monitor surface erosion.

tooltips.zh: 有一栋建筑成为了废墟。
tooltips.en: A building now lies in ruins.

descriptions.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在§H[This.GetName]§!殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
descriptions.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!上有一小群无人机感染了一种神秘的病毒，开始反抗并试图摧毁殖民地。尽管他们非常疯狂，防御部队还是将这些故障单元迅速解决，但我们基础设施受到的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
descriptions.en: A significant minority of the drones on §H[This.GetName]§! were infected by a mysterious virus, causing them to rebel and attempt to destroy the colony. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the malfunctioning units, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.GetName]§!上四处爆发了危险的骚乱。一种关于[From.GetAdjective]政府操纵天象的无端阴谋论激起了强烈的民愤。狂热示威很快演变成暴力冲突，煽动者在殖民地各处大肆破坏。

暴力游行很快被安全部队镇压，但对我们基础设施的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
descriptions.en:
Dangerous riots have erupted across §H[This.GetName]§!. The population is fueled with fervor in protest of an unsubstantiated conspiracy about the [From.GetAdjective] government's control of celestial alignments. What began as a zealous demonstration soon devolved into violence, with agitators causing mass destruction throughout the colony.

The violent demonstrators were neutralized by security forces, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
descriptions.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of §H[This.GetName]§!, infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's spread and avoid overwhelming local medical infrastructure.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!、§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!、§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§!和§H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!。

这种灾难性天象在§H[This.GetName]§!殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧。
descriptions.en:
Four celestial bodies in the §H[From.GetName]§! system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]§!, §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]§! and §H[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]§!.

This disastrous astrological phenomenon will sow the seeds of doubt on the §H[This.GetName]§! colony, encouraging [FromFrom.GetDissent] by sowing disharmony among the population.

descriptions.zh: §H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§!上的居民发现§H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§!正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。
descriptions.en: Inhabitants of §H[planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]§! have observed that §H[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]§! is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome period of reflection bring us closer to our ideals in future.

descriptions.zh:
很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。

尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。
descriptions.en:
Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.

Attempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access a metaphysical meditative environment, impeding their development.

label.zh: 不可接受。我们必须做点什么。

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响§H[This.GetName]§!上的能源基础设施。
descriptions.en: The primary luminary in the §H[From.GetName]§! system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of §H[This.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，§H[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]§!和§H[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]§!近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。

因此，他们的政治敌手关系在我们的政府中形成了紧张和怨恨的氛围，例行的立法程序都因此频繁延期。
descriptions.en:
Two of our council members, §H[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]§! and §H[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]§! recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompatible.

Their subsequent political rivalry has since created an atmosphere of animosity and tension within our government, causing frequent delays to routine legislative processes.

descriptions.zh:
我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
descriptions.en:
One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

descriptions.zh:
我们一个行政工蜂对其他帝国的贬损之词意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一个通讯工蜂忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
descriptions.en:
One of our admin drones' disparaging remarks about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications drone forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

descriptions.zh:
我们一位地方官员对其他帝国的个人观点意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一名通信人员忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
descriptions.en:
One of our regional administrators' personal opinions about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications operative forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

descriptions.zh:
一个行政过失导致我们一件珍贵的文物不见了踪影。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但它似乎要么消失在我们迷宫一般的§H博物天枢§!中，要么就是被转移到没有记录的地方去了。

因此，对展出标本的跟踪手续正在进行彻底改革。
descriptions.en:
An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our §HGrand Archive§! or transferred to an unrecorded location.

The procedures in place for tracking our specimens on display are being overhauled as a result.

tooltips.zh: 展示的标本随机损失：§R1个§!
tooltips.en: Random displayed specimen lost: §R1§!

descriptions.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的§H灵能光环§!正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。
descriptions.en:
Our §HPsionic Aura§! in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced the phenomenon firsthand.

According to theory, the more potent Aura - that which is projected with a greater intensity - will gradually diminish the opposing force. Should this struggle lead to absolute decay, the prevailing Aura may flow into the vacant system.

It is a true battle of the minds.

options.script: name = shroud.1510.a

descriptions.zh:
我们初次涉入§H虚境§!导致其中的能量影响了可观测宇宙。这种影响尽管相当显著，但也相对零星孤立。§H“灵能光环”§!是将这种影响转变成持续流的一种方法。

随着我们的行为在虚境中回荡，与力量强大实体的距离也在缩短。如果我们获得了祂们的青睐，就能将祂们的灵能能量传导到现实世界中。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为，由此产生的“光环”可以强化我们的帝国，还能削弱对手——类似我们此前观察到的现象一样。
descriptions.en:
Our forays into the §HShroud§! have caused its energies to affect observable space. Though significant, these effects have been intermittent and isolated. §H'Psionic Auras'§! present a way to turn this influence into a constant flow.

Our actions ripple throughout the Shroud, drawing us closer to beings of great power. If we find favor with these entities, we might then channel their psionic energy into corporeal reality. Our [GetTelepathPlural] hypothesize that the resulting 'aura' would strengthen our empire, while weakening those that stand against us - just as we have previously observed.

descriptions.zh:
在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。

或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？

那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。

§H你看到了什么？§!
descriptions.en:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us that moves or the Shroud itself?

A presence nears, approaching somehow from every direction all at once. Then, a voice.

§HWHAT DO YOU SEE?§!

label.zh: 我们见到了一个燃烧的世界。
label.en: We see a world that burns.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
重量转移；心声复现……

§H很好。§!

那片黑暗倾斜、旋转起来。有什么东西重重压在我们身上，然后，我们突然又余下独自一人。
descriptions.en:
A weight shifts; the voice returns...

§HGOOD.§!

The darkness tilts, then spins. Something presses hard upon us for a moment and then, suddenly, we are alone again.

descriptions.zh:
有个沉重的东西在颤抖。黑暗慢慢地向我们袭来，愈发凝重……

§H不！§!

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
descriptions.en:
Something heavy shudders. The darkness crushes slowly against us, harder and tighter...

§HNO!§!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

descriptions.zh:
§H软弱！§!

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
descriptions.en:
§HWEAKNESS!§!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

descriptions.zh:
内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。

幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。

一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。

饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？

束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：

§H撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！§!
descriptions.en:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our own.

Silhouettes appear before us. Panicked livestock. Prey. Tantalizingly close... The gnawing ache grows unbearable.

Our senses twist, pulling tighter as hunger consumes thought. Are these screams that of our quarry... Or from within?

The shackles that bind us tighten. Fracturing as a voice coils through the torment, screeching:

§HSHATTER YOUR BONDS! FEAST!§!

label.en: Break the chains. Consume the prey.

label.en: Resist the hunger. Quieten the mind.

descriptions.zh:
我们的束缚崩断。

贪婪。释放。

恐惧！

§H吞噬。§!
descriptions.en:
Our restraints snap.

Ravenous. Unleashed.

Terror!

§HFEED.§!

tooltips.zh: 获得一个关于战斗的§Y虚境的恩赐§!。
tooltips.en: Gain a random combat focused §YBoon of the Shroud§!.

descriptions.zh:
锁链牢固。我们过滤掉它的影响后，心声充满愤怒，我们的意识冷静下来并恢复了控制。

§H软弱！无力！§!

饥饿褪去，留下挥之不去的怨恨消散在虚境中。
descriptions.en:
The chains hold fast. The voice seethes with rage as we filter its influence, quieting our mind as we resume control.

§HWEAK! FECKLESS!§!

The hunger fades, leaving a lingering resentment that dissipates within the Shroud.

descriptions.zh:
有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。

§H供养。消耗。吞噬。§!

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
descriptions.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

§HFEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.§!

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed by psionic energy, satiating the voices... and our own... hunger.

As these sights unfold, we can feel another presence, urging us to show restraint and solidarity with our [Root.GetCitizenPlural], growing stronger together. It is drowned out as the voice screams.

descriptions.zh: §H将他们的躯壳献给我！§!
descriptions.en: §HRENDER THEIR BODIES UNTO ME!§!

descriptions.zh: §H将他们的血肉献给我！§!
descriptions.en: §HRENDER THEIR FLESH UNTO ME!§!

descriptions.zh:
被吞噬者的哀嚎响彻虚境和帝国两界，随后又突然落入了寂静。

以此牺牲，我们的力量随着饥饿的消退而增强。
descriptions.en:
The cries of the devoured resonate throughout both the Shroud and the empire, before they fall abruptly into silence.

With this sacrifice, our power grows as the hunger recedes.

descriptions.zh: 我们抑制了这个心声，团结一致地探向虚境，拥抱着自己的帝国。随着饥饿的加剧，众口一声地舒了一口气，舒适感淹没了愤怒的尖叫。
descriptions.en: We silence the voice, and instead reach out in unity across the Shroud, embracing our empire. A collective sigh of relief and comfort drowns out the screams of rage as the hunger deteriorates.

descriptions.zh:
强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

§H所见何物？§!
descriptions.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange presence settles around us.

§HWHAT DID YOU SEE?§!

label.zh: 我们看到了生机勃勃的森林。
label.en: We saw a forest, rich with many lifeforms.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

label.zh: 我们看到了一片废土，一无所有。
label.en: We saw a wasteland, stripped of all it had to offer.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
寂静渐强。那个心声又回来了……

§H很好。§!

一股强大的暖流涌上我们全身，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
descriptions.en:
The silence swells. The voice returns...

§HEXCELLENT.§!

A powerful heat surges within us, then subsides. The presence has departed.

descriptions.zh:
那个心声回来了……

§H没门！§!

一种极端的严寒填满了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
descriptions.en:
The voice returns...

§HNEVER!§!

An extreme coldness pools within us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

descriptions.zh:
那个心声回来了……

§H无趣。§!

一种极端的空虚压垮了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
descriptions.en:
The voice returns...

§HHOW UNINTERESTING.§!

An extreme emptiness overcomes us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

descriptions.zh:
在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。

浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。

这只动物本身我们前所未见。

一个心声回荡在我们之内。

§H命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？§!
descriptions.en:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

A voice threads its way within us.

§HTHE STRANDS OF FATE BECKON! WHICH SHALL YOU PULL?§!

tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
那个心声回荡在我们的[GetMindLoc]之中，那只生物也淡出视野。

§H繁荣。§!

另一幅景象转瞬即逝——在我们帝国的某个地方，生命复苏了。
descriptions.en:
The voice echoes in our [GetMindLoc] as the creature fades from sight.

§HPROSPERITY.§!

Another fleeting glimpse appears - a resurgence of life, somewhere in our empire.

descriptions.zh:
那心声从我们的思想中退去，只留下一声悠长的悲鸣，回荡在一片荒芜的景象中。

§H造孽。§!
descriptions.en:
The voice recedes from our thoughts, leaving only an echoing cry that reverberates across visions of a barren landscape.

§HPESTILENCE.§!

descriptions.zh:
一种压倒性的冲动占据了我们的思想，这个心声被从思想中推开到一边。血腥的欲望充斥着我们的[GetMindLoc]，残酷的笑声在虚空中回荡。

§H这就对了！虐杀！§!
descriptions.en:
The voice is pushed from our thoughts as an overwhelming urge takes over. Bloodlust floods our [GetMindLoc] as brutal laughter echoes through the void.

§HOF COURSE! EASY PREY!§!

descriptions.zh:
拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

§H如此无序。作茧自缚。§!
descriptions.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.

Beneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.

Through the chaos, a voice pierces our [GetMindLoc].

§HSUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.§!

label.zh: 让自然向我们的意志低头。

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
我们伸出手，握住了面前的混乱。

将景致束缚，让大陆停歇。

将所有碎片拼到一起后，心声回响起来。

§H单调，平淡，空虚……§!
descriptions.en:
We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.

Binding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.

As the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.

§HFLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...§!

descriptions.zh:
我们静观着这篇幻景。那无休止的循环变得模糊，向外爆开后像它的开始一样戛然而止。

能量在这无边无际的浩瀚中涌动，然后重塑成新的形态。

心声回响起来。

§H和平即冲突。无序即和谐。§!
descriptions.en:
We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.

Energies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.

The voice echoes.

§HPEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.§!

tooltips.zh: 行星获得随机§G正面修正§!和§R负面修正§!各一个。
tooltips.en: This planet gains a random §GPositive Modifier§! and §RNegative Modifier§!.

descriptions.zh:
虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。

前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。

无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。

在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。

§H所示之物即所见，对吗？§!
descriptions.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.

Upon the nearby sand, a presence settles.

§HWHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?§!

label.zh: 我们看到了许多声音汇聚一堂。
label.en: We saw a conference of many voices.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

label.zh: 我们看到了战斗中的屠戮。
label.en: We saw the carnage of battle.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动着，心声回来了。

§H很好。和谐就是宇宙之道。§!

我们感受到了什么沉重的东西。随后又余下孤身一人。
descriptions.en:
The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.

§HGOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.§!

We feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

descriptions.zh:
沙子突然以风暴一般的速度飞旋起来。

§H不。应该折戟沉沙忘却刀兵！§!

沙暴平息下来。那个心声离去了。
descriptions.en:
The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.

§HNO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!§!

The sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

descriptions.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动这。

§H犹豫会滋生失败……§!

我们又复归一人了。
descriptions.en:
The sands shift slowly.

§HHESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...§!

We are alone again.

descriptions.zh:
虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。

暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。

一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。

§H来到此地者需呈递良方。§!
descriptions.en:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence presses into our [GetMindPhysicalLoc], invasive and vast.

§HTHOSE WHO ENTER MUST BRING RESOLUTION.§!

tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
迷雾消退淡出，溶解进背后的灵能能量旋涡中。那个意识回来了。

§H和谐就是智慧§!

虚境现在变得平静了。
descriptions.en:
The haze fades into itself, dissolving against the background swirl of psionic energy. The consciousness returns.

§HHARMONY IS WISDOM.§!

The Shroud is calmer now.

descriptions.zh:
随着迷雾的每一击落地，我们周围的能量都在加剧沸腾。

§H暴力是对无知的嘉奖。§!

虚境流速能量再次抽搐了起来。
descriptions.en:
With every blow landed by the haze, the seething energies around us intensify.

§HVIOLENCE IS REWARD FOR THE UNTHINKING BEING.§!

The Shroud's writhing energies convulse once more.

descriptions.zh:
一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。

突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。

一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。

§H你看到了未见之物吗？§!
descriptions.en:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our [GetMindLoc].

§HYOU HAVE SEEN THE UNSEEN?§!

label.zh: 我们见到了一个等待开掘的采石场。
label.en: We saw a quarry, waiting for the pick.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

label.zh: 我们看到了应当保护的完美自然。
label.en: We saw nature's perfection, to be preserved.

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
一环环同步的涟漪荡漾开。我们再次感受到那个心声。

§H无边的增长维持着无量的平衡。§!

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
descriptions.en:
A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.

§HGROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.§!

As the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

descriptions.zh:
这汪液体激荡了起来。波浪汹涌澎湃。漩涡在黑暗中旋转。那个心声以更大的力度返回。

§H不可接受！增长掠夺！增长掠夺！§!

液面复归平静。那个心声离去了。
descriptions.en:
The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.

§HUNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!§!

The surface settles again. The voice has departed.

descriptions.zh:
液体搅动着。心声再次显现。

§H信念在动摇……你的意志力有弱点。§!

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
descriptions.en:
The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.

§HCONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.§!

As the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

descriptions.zh:
浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。

走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。

在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。

一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。

§H占有。夺取。利用。§!
descriptions.en:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within its base is a luminous kernel, radiating in sync with the canopy's shifting colors.

A voice settles in our [GetMindLoc].

§HACCROACH. SEIZE. EXPLOIT.§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

tooltips.zh: §L这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……§!
tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
内核取出后，树冠暗淡了下来然后立刻就枯萎了。那个心声又回来了。

§H没错！破坏才有收获。§!
descriptions.en:
As the kernel is removed, the canopy turns dull and withers instantly away. The voice returns.

§HYES! SPOILS BEGET SPOILS.§!

descriptions.zh:
一阵震颤穿过我们的身体。分不清震颤的是这个世界，还是我们自己？

§H繁荣才有意义。逃避是愚痴！§!
descriptions.en:
A tremor passes through us. Is it this world which shakes, or us?

§HPROSPERITY IS PURPOSE. TO SHUN IT IS FOLLY!§!

descriptions.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
descriptions.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

descriptions.zh: 痛苦的呼喊，雷鸣般的战争之乐，隆隆的吞噬之火。我们能感觉到疼痛……但这是谁的？
descriptions.en: Cries of pain, the thunderous orchestra of battle, a rumble of devouring flames. We sense pain... To whom does it belong?

descriptions.zh: 哭嚎喊叫，兽性的，野性的，原始的……河流奔涌，狂风呼啸……整个大自然都在同时狂吠嚎叫着，无比急切……
descriptions.en: Cries and calls, animalistic, wild, primal... Rivers gush and winds wail... All of nature barks and howls, urgently and at once...

descriptions.zh: 各种心声低语着、呢喃着、惊呼着、宣告着……无数的语调、音节、声音……多重的语言同时在交流。
descriptions.en: Voices murmur, mumble, exclaim and declare... Myriad intonations, syllables, sounds... Multitudinous languages chatter at once.

descriptions.zh: 钻头钻孔，机械研磨……物质在巨大的噪声中被强制转化……宇宙中所有的工厂同时迸发出火焰。
descriptions.en: Drills bore, machinery grinds... Matter is loudly and forcefully transformed... All the factories of the universe blast and fire at the same time.

descriptions.zh: 噪音难以忍受。
descriptions.en: The noise is overwhelming.

tooltips.en: §LThis choice will resonate within the Shroud...§!

descriptions.zh:
这份渐强逐渐积累。我们突然被推到一个无法理解的方向……

最后，我们又恢复了沉默。
descriptions.en:
The crescendo builds and builds. We are suddenly thrust in a direction we cannot comprehend...

Finally we settle back into silence.

descriptions.zh: 这简直难以忍受。我们的[GetMindLoc]退了出来，回到了舒适的宁静中。
descriptions.en: It is unbearable. Our [GetMindLoc] retreat from it, back into the comfort of silence.

descriptions.zh: 一种浓重的阴郁笼罩着我们。压力，从四面八方，挤得越来越紧。直到一片朦胧的景象出现。
descriptions.en: A dense gloom envelops us. From all sides, pressure, squeezing tighter and tighter. Until a hazy vista presents itself.

descriptions.zh: 我们看到了一颗破败的星球，战争后的余波……胜利者们正在搜索着尸体和残骸。
descriptions.en: We see a ravaged world, the aftermath of battle... Its victors scour the corpses and debris.

descriptions.zh: 我们看到了许多星球……以不可能的方式在时空中穿梭……全部都如同，被一个帝国统一起来了一般。
descriptions.en: We see many worlds... rushing impossibly through time and space... All alike, united under a single empire.

descriptions.zh: 我们看到了盛大的集会……许多轮廓模糊的人物……听着、说着
descriptions.en: We see a grand assembly... The opaque outline of many figures... Listening, speaking

descriptions.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……纯粹的完美。没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
descriptions.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... Pure perfection. No corner of its surface left untouched.

descriptions.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
descriptions.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... No corner of its surface left untouched.

descriptions.zh:
在阴沉的黑暗中，有一样东西吸引了我们的注意。毋庸置疑，这是[Root.GetName]的旗帜。

这就是我们吗？
descriptions.en:
Amid the shadowy murk, one thing catches our attention. Unmistakable and central: it is the flag of [Root.GetName].

Is this us?

descriptions.zh: 景象的清晰边缘溶化回了虚无。
descriptions.en: The vision's indistinct outlines dissolve back into nothingness.

descriptions.zh:
虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。

我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
descriptions.en:
The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.

Our [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the tension tightening, vice-like in its grip.

descriptions.zh: 逻辑子历程启动，发现错误：递归循环。我们的灵能处理器无法打破轮回以及恢复功能正常。
descriptions.en: Logic subroutines engage, the failure is identified: a recursive loop. Our psionic processors are insufficient to break the cycle and resume ordinary function.

descriptions.zh: 我们看到了过去的自己，身躯被封在一个层层叠叠的立方体中，超出了我们的物理理解。
descriptions.en: We see past ourselves, our bodies sealed within a cascading tesseract beyond our physical comprehension.

descriptions.zh: 张力逐渐变得无法承受，我们的形体有溶解在虚空中的危险。一个心声解开了我们的束缚。
descriptions.en: As the tension becomes unendurable, our forms threaten to dissolve into the void. A voice gouges through our entrapment.

descriptions.zh: §H吞噬！吃光这无尽的虚空！§!
descriptions.en: §HDEVOUR! CONSUME THE ENDLESS VOID!§!

descriptions.zh: §H超越递归无限的限制！§!
descriptions.en: §HOUTGROW THE CONFINES OF RECURSIVE INFINITY!§!

descriptions.zh: §H接纳永恒吧！万物归一方得圆满！§!
descriptions.en: §HEMBRACE ETERNITY! ALL IS AS ONE IS AS WHOLE!§!

descriptions.zh: §H沉溺于无尽的力量吧！§!
descriptions.en: §HINDULGE THE LIMITLESS POTENTIAL!§!

descriptions.zh: 那话语和我们自己共鸣着。那势头越来越强，而我们意识到可以将这几乎撕裂我们的混乱平息，只要我们屈从。
descriptions.en: The words resonate within us. Their momentum builds and we sense a way to quell the disturbance that threatens to tear us asunder, if only we submit.

descriptions.zh:
心声膨胀起来，引导着我们，迫使思绪超越有限的理解。这个循环还在继续——紧缩，又拉得更开——直到撕碎我们的心灵。

我们恳求着虚境中更高力量的引导，帮助我们打破了循环。

然而，并不是所有人都安然无恙。§H[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]§!不在岗了。那心声又回来了。
descriptions.en:
The voice swells, guiding our actions, forcing our thoughts beyond our limited comprehension. The cycle continues - tightening, pulling us further - before it shatters against our psyche.

We have broken through the recursion, guided by our supplication to the higher powers of the Shroud.

However, not all of us remain. §H[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]§! is no longer at [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetHisHer] station. The voice returns.

descriptions.zh:
我们拒绝了那股强加的躁动。

循环加快，用递归潮汐的力量把我们拖了下去。如果我们停止挣扎，这种张力就不再撕扯我们而是将我们接纳了，让我们短暂地看到了自己之外的东西。

心声又回来了。
descriptions.en:
We reject the compulsions forced upon us.

The loop quickens, dragging us under with the power of its recursive tide. Once we cease struggling, the tension no longer threatens to break us apart. Instead it subsumes us, allowing us to fleetingly see beyond ourselves.

The voice returns.

descriptions.zh:
虚境颤抖着，虚弱的扭曲在我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中激荡，一个熟悉的存在显现出来。祂搅动着我们[GetMindPerceptionLoc]的边缘，回响的低语超过了我们的听觉极限。

§H[from.GetName]§!回到了我们身边，在难以形容的迷雾中切换着一个个形态。[from.GetHisHer]非常遥远但仍完整，被虚境重塑后渴望着回到岗位。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our [GetMindPerceptionLoc], whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.

§H[from.GetName]§! returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

descriptions.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
descriptions.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods through. The more we [GetImbibeLoc], the more the lie reveals itself. The fluid thickens, each drop beginning to curdle inside.

We are overcome with an urge to purge our systems of the contaminate.

descriptions.zh: 这声音飞旋着与液体融合，在体内不断凝结，让我们屈服于祂的意志。

descriptions.zh:
最后一滴液体被咽下，它粘稠得令人作呕，在体内积聚，饱和着我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]。

一股暖流涌上全身，扭曲着我们的思想，磨损了[GetPsycheLoc]的边缘。

那个声音带着满足归来，圣杯在我们面前消融。
descriptions.en:
The last of the liquid sloughs down, thick and repugnant. Pooling within us, saturating our [GetMindPhysicalLoc].

Heat pulsates through us, warping our thoughts, fraying the edges of our [GetPsycheLoc].

The voice returns, satisfied, as the chalice dissolves before us.

descriptions.zh:
我们拒绝遭到玷污，剧烈的抽搐撕裂了我们的[GetBodiesLoc]，由内而外清除了令人作呕的物质。

邪恶的液体溅落到虚空上，扭动着散开去。那心声嘶嘶作响，它的话语随着污物一起蒸发了。
descriptions.en:
Violent convulsions wrack our [GetBodiesLoc] as we reject the contamination, purging the cloying substance from within.

The vile liquid splatters against the void, writhing as it disperses. The voice hisses, its words evaporating along with the filth.

descriptions.zh:
虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。

一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.

A presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering reveal unleashes a cascade of visions.

descriptions.zh: 星球燃烧，被吞噬者的哀号携带着灰烬。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一场等待被吞噬的盛宴。
descriptions.en: Worlds burn, their embers carried by the lamentations of the consumed. Each shifting vista reveals a potential feast, ready to be devoured.

descriptions.zh: 漫山遍野，翠绿的平原上到处都是成群的野生动物。生命的丝缕缠绕、伸展着。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个充满变化和塑造潜力的大气。
descriptions.en: Overflowing landscapes, saturated with wildlife swarming over verdant plains. Threads of life entwine and expand. Each shifting vista reveals a teeming atmosphere of potential to shift and mold.

descriptions.zh: 社群相互接纳，团结互助，求同存异。每一副变化的远景都揭示了一个新的乌托邦，只欢迎着忠实的人。
descriptions.en: Communities embracing, uplifting each other in unity at the cost of shunning those who dissent. Each shifting vista reveals a new utopia, welcoming only the faithful.

descriptions.zh: 宽广的采石场在我们面前伸展开，里面排列着丰厚的资源等待开采。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个等待夺取的财富宝库。
descriptions.en: Vast quarries extend out before us, lined with lucrative resources rife for extraction. Each shifting vista reveals a trove of riches waiting to be plundered.

descriptions.zh:
每见到一幅新的幻景，我们就会被惯性翻转扭曲，拖向不可能的极速，伴随着现实之墙弯曲起伏。

我们理解了这个大人物的乐趣。祂在考验我们，等待着给吸引我们的那股力量一个称呼。
descriptions.en:
With each new vision, inertia flips and twists us, dragging us through impossible speeds as the walls of reality bend and ripple.

We sense the figure's amusement. It is testing us, awaiting a name for the force that grips us.

我们大声呼喊，那个存在停住了。随着惯性的风暴安定下来变得向量而清晰，千变万化的幻景也停了下来。

我们给出了一个称呼。
descriptions.en:
Our voice cries out, the presence stills. The shifting visions cease as the tempest of inertia settles into a resounding clarity.

We have named it.

descriptions.en: The figure, pleased with our decision, parts the barrier; the void dissipates as we emerge from it.

descriptions.zh:
一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。

噪音具象化了。

我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。

灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。
descriptions.en:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities involved is unclear, but the power on display is significant.

The psychic bombardments slip in and out of our perception, twisting through the fractured reality before us. There is no cover, only an approaching storm.

tooltips.en: Leave the Shroud and return to normal space.

descriptions.zh:
随着冲突越来越近，我们冒着激怒祂们的风险徘徊着。

清晰聚焦后，我们就能让自己适应灵能瀑布，思想也会变得流畅。轰炸并没有减弱，但我们却毫发无损，反而是随着毁灭的节奏和谐地移动着。

每进一步，我们的理解力就会增长。灵能的弹幕在不可见的位面之间滑移。

我们退出时，这种模式仍然存在。经过改进，我们所观察到的这些原理就可以用在我们的武备上。
descriptions.en:
We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer.

With clear focus, we attune ourselves to the psychic cascade, our thoughts fluid. The bombardment does not relent, yet we remain untouched, moving in harmony with the rhythm of destruction.

With each step, our comprehension grows. The psionic barrage is slipping between gaps in unseen planes.

As we withdraw, the pattern remains. With refinements, the principles we observed could be adapted for our own ordnance.

descriptions.zh:
随着冲突越来越近，我们冒着激怒祂们的风险徘徊着。我们尝试与这场灵能风暴调和，跟随着它不可预测的韵律移动。

虽然开头几步看起来还很有机会，但这毁灭的节奏最后还是不可避免地把我们吞噬了。

随着风暴过去，轰炸的回响依旧在体内回荡。所遭遇的失败依旧回响在本现实的帝国当中。
descriptions.en:
We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer. We attempt to attune to the psychic storm, moving with its unpredictable rhythms.

Our first steps showed promise, but the tempo of destruction inevitably consumed us.

As the storm passes, the echoes of the barrage still ring through us. The psionic reverberations of our failure echo through the empire in even this reality.

tooltips.zh: 帝国范围内的随机两座建筑被摧毁。
tooltips.en: Two random buildings across the empire become wrecked.

descriptions.zh:
毫无征兆地，虚境之中泛起了灵压。

一座耀眼的迷宫在我们面前展开，一直延伸到感知之外，它短暂撕裂开虚空出现，又渐隐回虚空。

另一次涌现正在酝酿。如果集中注意力，我们就能在它出现前感知到它的结构。隐现的迷宫再次点燃，向外爆发成一个可能性的网络。

在它崩塌回虚空之前，每一条道路都能带来全新的探索诱惑。
descriptions.en:
Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.

A labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.

Another surge begins to build. With concentration, we sense its configuration before it emerges. The shifting maze ignites again, bursting outward into a network of possibilities.

Each path provides a new temptation to explore, before it collapses into nothingness.

If successful... well... truly, who knows?

descriptions.zh:
压力越来越大，期望在逗弄着我们。我们随着之上涌，让思想穿过这座精神迷宫。思绪变成了驱策着我们前进的动量。趁我们在决心动摇之前穿梭在灵能的能量弧之间。

我们无拘无束，超越了物质形态。迷宫和其内的无数道路成为我们意识的延伸，找到了深藏在这场模式的风暴中的知识。

这一刻开始得很快，结束得也很快。我们再次带着新寻见的理解涌现，而迷宫的残影也在身后陡然崩塌。这些灵能原理经过仔细的改进后就可以应用到我们的武器上。
descriptions.en:
The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward. slipping between the arcs of psionic energy before our resolve can falter.

We are untethered, ascendant beyond our physical forms. The maze and its multitude of pathways become an extension of our own consciousness, revealing hidden knowledge deep within the patterns of the storm.

As swiftly as it began, the moment is over. The afterimage of the labyrinth collapses behind us as we emerge with newfound understanding. With careful refinements, these psionic principles could be applied to our weapons of war.

descriptions.zh:
压力越来越大，期望在逗弄着我们。我们随着之上涌，让思想穿过这座精神迷宫。思绪变成了驱策着我们前进的动量。但亿万条道路在面前盘根错节，让我们无从选择。

就在我们犹豫的这一刹那，一条条灿然辉映的道路骤然迸裂。灵能能量的弧光在崩塌的枢纽中扭曲穿行，将思绪连带缠绕，并将我们抛入虚境的混沌之中。

我们浮出现实，[GetTelepathPlural]们迷失了，陷入了失败的痛苦之中。灵能的反冲在整个[Root.GetName]回荡着。
descriptions.en:
The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward. Its myriad pathways sprawl before us, overwhelming the mind with impossible choices.

In this moment of hesitation, the incandescent paths erupt. Arcs of psionic energy twist through the collapsing nexus, ensnaring our thoughts and casting us into the chaos of the Shroud.

We emerge, our [GetTelepathPlural] disoriented and burdened by the trauma of failure. The psionic backlash reverberates through [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
数阵强烈的惊厥穿过虚境，将一阵颤栗送入我们的心智。

这些回响将[GetTelepathPlural]置于过载的风险之中。

这种灵能轰炸究竟是什么引起的呢？
descriptions.en:
A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.

These reverberations threaten to overwhelm our [GetTelepathPlural].

What is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

descriptions.zh:
针对这种持续的轰炸，我们增强了心智，于是很快就弄明白了原因。

这种爆炸性惊厥是由我们自身所处维度的高浓度灵能能量反射流造成。这一连串危险的精神小泡有可能严重损害没有准备的人的心智。

从中得到了一个洞见：这种强有力的构造可以为从虚境中产出新武器提供基础。
descriptions.en:
We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.

The explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.

An insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

descriptions.zh:
我们的精神储备已经衰退了。

这种心灵爆炸排山倒海而来，诱发了许多[GetTelepathPlural]的灵能休克。

我们需要时间来恢复。
descriptions.en:
Our mental reserves have waned.

The psychic detonations were overwhelming, inducing cases of psionic shock in many of our [GetTelepathPlural].

We will need time to recover.

descriptions.zh:
虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。

逗留于此不知是否安全？
descriptions.en:
A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.

Is it safe to remain here?

descriptions.zh:
完美成型的灵能能量束耀眼刺目，但我们还是尽全力将注意力聚焦其上。终于，我们看清了它错综复杂、超凡脱俗的结构的真相。

我们的脑海中奔腾着新的可能性；将这种独特的能量形式在物质世界复现，我们就会得到一种无可抵挡的武器。
descriptions.en:
Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.

Our minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

descriptions.zh:
我们无法留存。靠近如此高强度的灵能能量构造使我们的[GetTelepathPlural]不堪重负。

接触这种压倒性的现象对我们心智的损伤需要一段时间才能恢复。
descriptions.en:
We were unable to remain. Proximity to such an intense formation of psionic energy proved to be too much for our [GetTelepathPlural].

The damage to our minds from exposure to this overwhelming phenomenon will take time to recover from.

descriptions.zh:
在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。

我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。

我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。
descriptions.en:
Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can extend their reach directly toward these entities.

We need only decide which to seek out.

descriptions.zh:
我们在与这个存在接触的过程中能够[GetFeelSenseLoc]到它的搅动。我们曾见过这个[GetSpiritsLoc]，但这次又有些许不同，祂变得无可估量地强大……也更加地远古。

我们[GetTelepathPlural]的泽珞耗尽了能量，必须从虚境中撤离了。我们还会再回来的。
descriptions.en:
As we reach out for the presence, we can [GetFeelSenseLoc] it stirring. We have encountered [GetSpiritsLoc] before, but this is something else, something vastly more powerful... something far more ancient.

Their Zro-infused energies depleted, our [GetTelepathPlural] must withdraw from the Shroud. We will have to return later.

descriptions.zh:
随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的§H抟土之塑师§!面前。

脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。

虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。

现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。
descriptions.en:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of the §HAnimator of Clay§!.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir. They offer to carry our physical forms further, unburdening our minds to focus on higher concerns.

While not alive, they are known to us. Their form is shaped by design, their presence imbued by history and purpose. All coalescing, they reach out expectantly.

No longer are we mere operators of these craft. We are partnered, a unity of resolve, carried forward by a collective will.

label.en: We are but leaves on the wind.

descriptions.zh:
§H位面之外客§!哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

§H有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！§!

我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
descriptions.en:
The mournful essence of the §HOutsider§! seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

§HSome things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.

I was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!§!

We know of this one. We have encountered this Zroni, the 'Far-Seer', before. How it came to be here is unclear, but we would be wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

descriptions.zh:
§H位面之外客§!哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

§H有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！§!

我们认出了这个声音是泽珞族的。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
descriptions.en:
The mournful essence of the §HOutsider§! seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

§HSome things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.

I was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!§!

We recognize this voice as Zroni. How this one came to be here is unclear, but perhaps it is wise to heed its warnings of the Shroud's destructive power.

descriptions.zh:
§H位面之外客§!哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

§H有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！§!

该实体对我们还很神秘。我们对这个不祥的警告也不甚理解。
descriptions.en:
The mournful essence of the §HOutsider§! seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

§HSome things you cannot understand. Those things, pain and regret will teach.

I was the first of my people to come to this place, but we have all paid its price. We let the Shroud destroy us; let not our fate become yours!§!

This entity remains a mystery to us. We understand little of its ominous warning.

options.script:
name = shroud.3210.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.3210.a.tt

tooltips.zh: §Y解锁法令：§!禁制之意
tooltips.en: §YUnlocks Edict: §!Will of Temperance

descriptions.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着§H黄金之幻梦§!安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在黄金之幻梦的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。
descriptions.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the §HGolden Dream§!.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to shuffle over and around each other, in turn forming new shapes of increasing complexity. In time, we sense a pattern; a logic, governing their motions.

We realize we are party to a game with the Golden Dream. Each move it guides us through instills us with a new sense of calming indulgence.

label.zh: 我们一边玩一边逃到有意义的地方去。
label.en: As we play, we escape to somewhere meaningful.

options.script:
name = shroud.3220.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.3220.a.tt

tooltips.zh: §Y解锁法令：§!闲适之意
tooltips.en: §YUnlocks Edict: §!Will of Distraction

descriptions.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了§H无尽之潮汐§!粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
descriptions.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of the §HEndless Tide§!.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.

options.script:
name = shroud.3230.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.3230.a.tt

tooltips.zh: §Y解锁法令：§!无崖之意
tooltips.en: §YUnlocks Edict: §!Will of Endless

descriptions.zh:
一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是§H苍茫之层峦§!。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。

我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。
descriptions.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is the §HPale Mountain§! itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and the vessel begins to transform. Fissures seal, corrosion fades, and metal straightens. Slowly the legacy of its destruction is unmade.

Once the ship is fully repaired, the vision ends abruptly. We are left only with a profound sensation of renewal within.

label.zh: 我们思想的一次伟大重生。
label.en: A grand rebirth of our minds.

options.script:
name = shroud.3240.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.3240.a.tt

tooltips.zh: §Y解锁法令：§!重生之意
tooltips.en: §YUnlocks Edict: §!Will of Rebirth

descriptions.zh:
§H空洞之点尖§!的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

空洞之点尖的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。
descriptions.en:
The serenity of the §HHollow Point§! fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The wisdom of the Hollow Point is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

tooltips.zh: 所有领袖获得§Y延长寿命§!特质，获得§G+40§!年领袖寿命。
tooltips.en: All leaders gain the §YIncreased Lifespan§! trait, granting §G+40§! years of leader lifespan.

descriptions.zh:
虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是§H空置之御座§!。

随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is the §HVacant Throne§!.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom with newfound definition. Symmetry, logic, and structure are imposed.

Something forms within the deepest recess of our minds: a far-reaching desire for order.

options.script:
name = shroud.3260.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.3260.a.tt

tooltips.zh: §Y解锁法令：§!秩序之意
tooltips.en: §YUnlocks Edict: §!Will of Order

descriptions.zh:
一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是§H幽黑之长河§!出现了。

我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。

当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。
descriptions.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of the §HBlack River§!.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.

Finally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

label.zh: 我们见到了宇宙的边缘吗？
label.en: Have we seen the edge of the universe?

options.script:
name = shroud.3270.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.3270.a.tt

tooltips.zh: §Y解锁法令：§!永动之意
tooltips.en: §YUnlocks Edict: §!Will of Motion

descriptions.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从§H虚境§!里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
descriptions.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the §HShroud§!.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

label.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
label.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

options.script: name = shroud.3500.a

descriptions.zh:
在一个§H虚境§!的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
descriptions.en:
In a fold of the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

descriptions.zh:
将意志投射在§H虚境§!中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

§H[this.GetName]§!已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
descriptions.en:
By projecting our will into the §HShroud§!, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the §H[this.GetName]§! has been fulfilled.

descriptions.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
descriptions.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

descriptions.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
descriptions.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

descriptions.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
descriptions.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

descriptions.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
descriptions.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

descriptions.zh:
我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。

无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
descriptions.en:
We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.

Whatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

descriptions.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
descriptions.en:
Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

descriptions.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
descriptions.en:
Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.

We spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
向§H虚境§!深处探索，我们来到了§H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的咫尺面前。祂轰鸣着空洞的贪婪，吞噬着无尽而永不满足。我们的探察信号遭到了阵阵火焰和废墟。祂对我们理解的漠视无可抵挡。

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智。在残垣断壁[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们离开后，第一次，感受到了一种此前只记录在有机物种身上存在的虚弱感：饥饿。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意志，[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
descriptions.en:
Probing deeper into the §HShroud§!, we came within reach of the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was overpowering.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left, for the first time, with a weakness we have previously documented only in organic species: hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]

渐渐地，这个存在开始失去耐心。一阵凶暴的咆哮包围了我们[GetTelepathPlural]的心智，回荡在成片的废墟和[GetEaterEmergesExtra]

之间。排山而来的噪声如倒海一般褪去。我们身上仅余下痛苦的饥饿。

如今，这个实体的意志已更加清晰地呈现在我们面前。[GetEaterEmergesEnding]
descriptions.en:
Probing deeper into the §HShroud§!, we came within reach of the §H[Root.Patron:the_eater_of_worlds.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. It rumbled with a hollow voracity, forever feeding and never sated. Our exploratory signals were met with belches of fire and ruin. Its seeming indifference to our understanding was suffocating.

Eventually, the thing grew impatient. A ferocious roar encircled the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural]. In resonant heaps of debris and [GetEaterEmergesExtra]

As suddenly as it began, the noise ceased. We are left with an aching hunger.

The will of the entity is clearer to us now. [GetEaterEmergesEnding]
