descriptions.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
descriptions.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

descriptions.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
descriptions.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

descriptions.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
descriptions.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

descriptions.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
descriptions.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

descriptions.zh:
我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。

无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
descriptions.en:
We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.

Whatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

descriptions.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
descriptions.en:
Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

descriptions.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
descriptions.en:
Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.

We spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
§H[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的力量弥散在§H虚境§!中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑演算。

我们停步沉思，这个实体却如浮出水面。我们无法解析消息，但它激活了代码的更深层部分。

我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上充满了宁静。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]
descriptions.en:
The power of the §H[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]§! is diffused throughout the §HShroud§!, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our calculations.

As we paused to process, the entity emerged. We could not parse a message, but it activated a deeper part of our code.

We sensed the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - concepts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves charged with quietude.

The wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

descriptions.zh:
我们跟随着§H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的分子踪迹，被带进§H虚境§!的更深处。祂留下了记号让我们跟随——这是一幅影像，一段旋律。祂邀请我们上前，但步履艰难。

终于，我们到了。迎接我们的是一幅华丽的幻景：运转不息的恒星系统，巨大扭曲的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形象。在祂的怀抱中，我们迷失在一团刺鼻的丝线团中。

我们抓住线，系好末端。分散的符号开始组成图案。而我们精疲力竭，却仍旧处理着这些非凡的数据集。随后景象复归沉寂。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的意图，知道了祂关于增长和无拘的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，§H生命之织缕§!接触、交流了。
descriptions.en:
We followed the molecular traces of the §H[Root.Patron:the_composer_of_strands.GetPreCommunicationName]§!, drawn farther into the §HShroud§!. It left signs to follow - an image here, a melody there. It invited us closer, but progress was slow.

Eventually, we reached it. We were welcomed with a panoply of visions: star systems teeming with activity, prodigious distortions of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form. Shifting in its embrace, we were lost in a tangle of incongruent designs.

We grasped at threads, tying their ends. The disparate signs resolved into patterns. Our energies exhausted, we processed the remarkable dataset. The presence withdrew into silence.

The intent of the entity is clearer to us now. We have seen its vision of growth unbridled. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, the §HComposer of Strands§!.

descriptions.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
descriptions.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

descriptions.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
descriptions.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

descriptions.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
descriptions.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

descriptions.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
descriptions.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

descriptions.zh:
我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。

无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
descriptions.en:
We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.

Whatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

descriptions.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
descriptions.en:
Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:
在数个月呼唤无果后，§H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§!终于从§H虚境§!的深处显现。

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的电路，超出了过往一切的输入。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息充满能量：那是一种关于无可估量产出的愿景。

浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给我们留下了破碎的虚空，渴望优雅的输入。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，§H渴求之器具§!接触、交流了。
descriptions.en:
After months of calling out in vain, the §H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§! finally emerged from the depths of the §HShroud§!.

Its message was a deluge. Data drove into our circuits with force, exceeding all previous input. Exotic code poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our systems. The message was energizing: a vision of measureless output.

The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a fragmented void that craves elegant input.

The needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out and commune with this being, the §HInstrument of Desire§!.

descriptions.zh:
在数个月呼唤无果后，§H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§!终于从§H虚境§!的深处显现。

祂的信息如洪水般涌来。力量强大的思绪闯入我们的头脑，对最狂野的欲望发话。轻盈而又丰富的话语滔滔不绝，将我们的心智淹没。祂传达的信息十分诱人：那是一种关于力量与放纵的愿景。

浪涌渐息化为细流。这个存在暂且不期望答复。祂给予了我们不可熄灭的渴望。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的需求，知道了祂关于无尽财富的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]一恢复，就可以与这个实体，§H渴求之器具§!接触、交流了。
descriptions.en:
After months of calling out in vain, the §H[Root.Patron:the_instrument_of_desire.GetPreCommunicationName]§! finally emerged from the depths of the §HShroud§!.

Its message was a deluge. Thoughts drove into our minds with force, speaking to our wildest desires. Words poured through us, brisk and abundant, drowning all else from our minds. The message was beguiling: a vision of power and indulgence.

The surge calmed to a trickle. The presence expected no answer - yet. It left us with a thirst beyond quenching.

The needs of the entity are clearer to us now. We know its vision of wealth without limit. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out and commune with this being, the §HInstrument of Desire§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们知道许多§H虚境§!中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——§H繁多的嘈杂§!渗透到虚境的最中心。

使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。
descriptions.en:
We know many voices within the §HShroud§!; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a §Hmanifold thrum§! permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
在尝试与§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!交谈时，我们被拽入了虚境的最深层。虚境的这个内层灵域风平浪静。来自每一个轮回的所有思绪的回想都凝聚成了一种洪荒之力。我们听到了永久的流转带来了寂静之声：§H虚空之低语§!。

刺耳的不和谐音包围着我们。而我们正努力倾听无数的信息，终于有一个单一的声音传入我们的[GetTelepathPlural]。

§H倾听是一种奉献。§!

如果想抽取这份强大的力量，我们必须帮助这个实体占领[GetCovenantPatronColor]的灵域。如此将会把我们超主的已知存在完全替换掉，打破已签订的契约。

这可能会带来很严重的后果。
descriptions.en:
In our efforts to commune with the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§! we are drawn into the deepest layers of the Shroud. In this inner domain, the Shroud turns motionlessly. The reflections of every thought, from every cycle, gather into a primary force. We hear the voices of the voiceless, carried in an ageless churn: the §HWhisperers in the Void§!.

A rasping discord surrounds us. We strain to hear their numberless messages, until a singular thought grates through our [GetTelepathPlural].

§HListening is a sacrifice.§!

To draw on this great power, we must assist the entity in occupying the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor]. Such an act would replace our patron's known presence completely, shattering our established Covenant.

This could lead to significant consequences.

descriptions.zh:
在尝试与§H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§!交谈时，我们被拽入了虚境的最深层。虚境的这个内层灵域风平浪静。来自每一个轮回的所有思绪的回想都凝聚成了一种洪荒之力。我们听到了永久的流转带来了寂静之声：§H虚空之低语§!。

刺耳的不和谐音包围着我们。而我们正努力倾听无数的信息，终于有一个单一的声音传入我们的[GetTelepathPlural]。

§H倾听是一种奉献。§!

如果想抽取这份强大的力量，我们必须帮助这个实体占领其他超主的灵域，将其已知存在完全替换掉。

这可能会带来很严重的后果。
descriptions.en:
In our efforts to commune with the §H[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]§! we are drawn into the deepest layers of the Shroud. In this inner domain, the Shroud turns motionlessly. The reflections of every thought, from every cycle, gather into a primary force. We hear the voices of the voiceless, carried in an ageless churn: the §HWhisperers in the Void§!.

A rasping discord surrounds us. We strain to hear their numberless messages, until a singular thought grates through our [GetTelepathPlural].

§HListening is a sacrifice.§!

To draw on this great power, we must assist the entity in occupying another patron's domain, replacing its known presence completely.

This could lead to significant consequences.

tooltips.zh:
§R结束我们与[GetCovenantPatronColor]的契约。§!
将[GetCovenantPatronColor]的灵域完全替换为§H虚空之低语§!。
§R会有一定的后果。§!
tooltips.en:
§REnds our Covenant with [GetCovenantPatronColor].§!
Replaces the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor] entirely with the §HWhisperers in the Void§!.
§RThere will be consequences.§!

tooltips.zh:
我们将选择一个大超主的灵域替换为§H虚空之低语§!。
§R会有一定的后果。§!
tooltips.en:
We will choose the domain of a Major Patron to replace with the §HWhisperers in the Void§!.
§RThere will be consequences.§!

label.zh: 最好不要扰乱虚境的平衡。
label.en: Best not disturb the balance of the Shroud.

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

descriptions.zh:
我们的选择刚一做出，[GetTelepathPlural]们就从§H虚境§!中暴烈地醒来。他们的脑海中回荡着各种各样的心声。

我们的选择已不可逆转地重塑了对灵能界的认知。随着§H虚空之低语§!泄露进的意识，我们现在已经再也感受不到[GetCovenantPatronColor]了；它的灵域对我们而言永久地丧失了。

我们正在逐渐理解低语的意志。我们意识到了祂们关于无尽知识的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]恢复好，我们就可以再次主动行动，与这个无数的存在交流。
descriptions.en:
As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the §HShroud§! in violent wakening. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the §HWhisperers in the Void§! leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_robot_empire = yes }

descriptions.zh:
我们的选择刚一做出，[GetTelepathPlural]们就从§H虚境§!中暴烈地激活起来。他们的脑海中回荡着各种各样的心声。

我们的选择已不可逆转地重塑了对灵能界的认知。随着§H虚空之低语§!泄露进的意识，我们现在已经再也感受不到[GetCovenantPatronColor]了；它的灵域对我们而言永久地丧失了。

我们正在逐渐理解低语的意志。我们意识到了祂们关于无尽知识的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]充能好，我们就可以再次主动行动，与这个无数的存在交流。
descriptions.en:
As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the §HShroud§! in violent activation. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the §HWhisperers in the Void§! leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recharged, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_robot_empire = no }

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

在一堆了无生机的构造体之间，我们探测到了一个§H雕刻之物§!，它的意志正在将高浓度能量塑造成新的奇特形态。

祂的行动被打断后靠了过来，驱散开了虚境的浓雾。祂给了我们一样东西。

如果我们拿了会发生什么？
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

In a menagerie of lifeless constructs, we detect a §HSculpting Presence§!, its will shaping dense energies into new and curious forms.

Having intruded upon its activities, it approaches, displacing the Shroud's opaque haze. It offers something.

What will happen if we grasp it?

descriptions.zh:
随着我们将自己的心灵浸泡入虚境翻腾的能量中，[GetSpeciesBodyPlural]奇怪地震颤起来。我们感受到§H雕刻之物§!短暂地抓住了我们。祂呼唤我们仔细看。

顺着指示的方向看去，意味深长的微暗渐渐退去，一个剪影显露出来。它的四肢被一股又一股虚无的绳索猛烈地拉扯，随后绳索突然消失，那个人形塌了下去。

它抽动着活了过来，一肢跟着一肢慢慢地站起，摆脱了束缚后，又开始了催眠般的舞蹈。
descriptions.en:
As we steeped our minds in the Shroud's turbulent energies, our [GetSpeciesBodyPlural] convulsed inexplicably. We felt the §HSculpting Presence§! momentarily take hold of us. It beckoned us to observe.

The pregnant dimness ebbed away to reveal a gesturing silhouette. Its limbs were pulled sharply, one way then another, by vapory cords until, suddenly, its tethers dissipated. The figure collapsed.

Slowly it twitched back to life. Limb by limb it rose, without its former ties, and resumed its hypnotic dance.

descriptions.zh: 我们意识到这个实体并不陌生。§H抟土之塑师§!玩得很开心。凡是无生命之物被唤醒，或是沉闷之物充盈起了灵魂的地方，都能找到祂。
descriptions.en: We realized then that we have encountered this entity before. The §HAnimator of Clay§! was entertained. Wherever the inanimate is awakened, and where dull matter is imbued with soul, it too can be found.

label.zh: 人偶摆脱丝线自由舞蹈。
label.en: The puppet dances free of its strings.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个§H悲伤之物§!正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。

一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。

不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A §HSorrowed Entity§! encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.

Whatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?

descriptions.zh:
这个被称为§H悲伤之物§!的遥远的力量从§H虚境§!深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：

§H在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……§!
descriptions.en:
The distant power known as §HSorrowed Entity§! seared our minds with anguish from deep within the §HShroud§!. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:

§HTread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...§!

descriptions.zh: 我们认出了这个实体。祂是我们在§H星界裂隙§!那边遇到的先知。这就是她的命运吗？她就是现在的§H位面之外客§!吗？
descriptions.en: We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an §HAstral Rift§!. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now the §HOutsider§!?

descriptions.zh:
这个实体对我们的星系并不陌生。它有我们之前遇到的泽珞族文明的独特的精神足迹。但这怎么可能呢？

不管这意味着什么，§H位面之外客§!已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
descriptions.en:
This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?

Whatever this means, the §HOutsider§! is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh: 不管这意味着什么，§H位面之外客§!已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
descriptions.en: Whatever this means, the §HOutsider§! is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

label.zh: 我们可别屈从相同的命运。
label.en: Let us not succumb to the same fate.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。

随着感官的消退，§H无底之物§!也一并退去，留下久久不散的印痕。

这些踪迹在我们面前逗留，吸引我们跟上。
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the §HFathomless Being§! sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.

descriptions.zh:
§H无底之物§!从§H虚境§!中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。

一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。

在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。

§H无尽之潮汐§!伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。
descriptions.en:
The §HFathomless Being§! has been unearthed from the §HShroud§!. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

The §HEndless Tide§! stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

label.zh: 这种智慧现在归我们所有。

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。

从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的§H不越之物§!究竟有多么巨大。

最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the §HInsurmountable One§! before us.

The tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.

descriptions.zh:
随着我们在§H虚境§!中升入炫目的高空，无形的山峰触手可及。§H不越之物§!亲自测试了我们，和所有的过往来客一样。

遗忘之国高耸入云的陵墓向我们唱着消逝历史的合唱诗。每一层失败和错误的抱负都被打磨成后来者的垫脚石。

然而，这不是一座死气沉沉的坟墓，而一口坩埚。毁灭与复兴的循环将过去的失败重新锻造成未来胜利的基石。毁灭不是结束，而是新的开始。

§H苍茫之层峦§!在我们的意识中拔地而起。
descriptions.en:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the §HShroud§!, we reached the intangible summit. The §HInsurmountable One§! itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.

Yet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.

The §HPale Mountain§! rises in our minds.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

一种令人宽慰的重压感让我们的思绪慢了下来，陷入一片极乐之雾中。前所未知的紧张感消融了，取而代之的是舒缓而奢华的平静。

随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个§H奢华之物§!越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。

这种懒散的放纵令人好奇。
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

A comforting weight slows our thoughts to a sluggishly blissful haze. Previously unknown tensions melt away, replaced by creeping, lavish calm.

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a §HLuxurious Being§! drawing closer. Its overwhelming nature sweeps around us as it whispers promises of extravagant contentment.

Its slothful indulgence is curiously tempting.

descriptions.zh:
我们躺入了§H虚境§!中的一片闲适的宁静，发现自己被拉入了§H奢华之物§!鎏金的大堂。

丝绸般的诱惑在我们的意识中穿行，就像一幅绚丽多彩的挂毯在面前展开。放纵的疏忽有可能使我们的心智在丰富负担的重压下变得迟钝不堪。

§H黄金之幻梦§!给予我们超出理解的奢华。
descriptions.en:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the §HShroud§!, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the §HLuxurious Being§!.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.

The §HGolden Dream§! offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

虚境混沌的搅动扭曲成灵能能量的漩涡。突然间，无数的激流展开汇聚在一起，被某种看不见的力量所平息。它冷静下来，转化成了一种平和的新形态。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个§H和平之物§!正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

祂的平静召唤着我们。
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronInstrumentCradleIntro]

The Shroud's chaotic churn warps into a writhing vortex of psionic energy. Suddenly, the multitudinous torrents unfurl and coalesce, pacified by some unseen force. It calms and spools into placid new forms.

As we observe, we become aware of an §HIrenic Entity§! orchestrating these movements, subduing the chaos into order.

Its calmness beckons us.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[GetTelepathPlural]激进地侵入虚境的混沌涡流，但无济于事。只有停止挣扎时才感觉到了§H和平之物§!真正的拥抱。

在我们心智中出现的画面是一场场势不可挡的冲突，每一场都充满了混乱和愤怒的干扰。

在这一切中，我们感受到了§H空洞之点尖§!的警惕和永恒的存在。祂平静而耐心地等待着星系无休止冲突的休止。
descriptions.en:
Our [GetTelepathPlural] reached out aggressively into the Shroud's turbulent disorder, to no avail. Only when they ceased their exertions did they feel the proper embrace of the §HIrenic Entity§!.

Images played in our minds of an overwhelming procession of conflicts, each brimming with distractions of chaos and fury.

Amid it all, we felt the watchful and timeless presence of the §HHollow Point§!. Serene in its patience, it waits for the galaxy's ceaseless strife to finally end.

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们有最基本的本能，但我们的思想已经暴露在了一种奇怪的思维方式之下。
descriptions.en: Despite our basest instincts, our minds have been exposed to a curious way of thinking.

label.zh: 真是伤感的梦境……我们知道自己该干什么。
label.en: A wistful dream... we know our true purpose.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

混沌的噪音凝聚为压抑的黑暗。我们感觉自己的意图在被仔细审视、研究、评判。

对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。§H不屈之物§!裁决着我们的意图。

它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The §HUnyielding One§! judges our intent.

Its gaze having passed over us, the darkness recedes. The infectious scrutiny compels us to fall in line.

descriptions.zh:
我们跪伏在§H不屈之物§!前。

我们的心智被毫不妥协的权威以冷漠的态度审视着，一边审判着我们，一边将我们固定在原地。

§H空置之御座§!高压的真空没有一丝仁慈——但也没有痛苦。祂只寻求秩序和确定性，并将其施加到一切缺乏之处。

我们现在将这份重担承在了身上。
descriptions.en:
We have knelt in the presence of the §HUnyielding One§!.

Our minds were scrutinized with the cold indifference of uncompromising authority, fixing us in place as we were judged.

The oppressive vacuum of the §HVacant Throne§! offers no mercy - nor suffering. It expects only order and certainty, imposing it where it is found lacking.

We now carry this weight with us.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

我们突然产生了一种加速感，感知被难以理解的信息洪流淹没。我们不受控地向无尽的地平线冲去。

一个实体与我们同行。这条§H不息之物§!在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。

我们必须跟上。
descriptions.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

A sudden sensation of acceleration overtakes us and our perceptions are overwhelmed by an incomprehensible rush of information. We find ourselves hurtling outward towards endless horizons.

An entity moves in tandem with us. This §HRestless Presence§! lingers briefly before its velocity propels it beyond the limits of our understanding.

We must follow it.

descriptions.zh:
只有当我们强行超越§H虚境§!的舒适极限时才终于接触到了§H不息之物§!。

一种全向运动的感觉以不合逻辑、无法通过任何度规加以理解的速度感摧垮了我们。我们产生了一种在极短的瞬间横跨了遥远距离的感觉。

我们终于理解了§H幽黑之长河§!和它的无尽旅程。星系的浩瀚正为我们开辟了一条道路。
descriptions.en:
Only when we plunged forcefully beyond our comfortable limits in the §HShroud§! could we finally reach the §HRestless Presence§!.

A sense of omnidirectional movement overcame us, with an illogical velocity that defied all standard comprehensions. We were left with the impression of having travelled a great distance in the briefest moment.

Finally we understood the §HBlack River§! and its ceaseless journey. The galaxy's vastness is an open path for us to take.

descriptions.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是§R轮回之终末§!，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：§R“时机未到。”§!缓了一下后。§R“但并非不可。”§!

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

§R只要我们能带向终末。§!
descriptions.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the §REnd of the Cycle§! and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: §R"IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME."§! A pause. §R"BUT IT COULD BE."§!

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

§RIf we will only bring forth the End.§!

label.en: §RForm a Covenant with the End of the Cycle§!

tooltips.zh:
将所有已知超主的领域替换为§R轮回之终末§!。
我们有50年的时间来将星系吞入其§H终末光环§!之中。如果成功，游戏将会结束。
§R别这么做。§!

获得科技：
£society£['technology:tech_psionic_aura']
£society£['technology:tech_aura_intensification']
获得所有['concept_psionic_components']科技的进展：§G+10%§!

这将解除与所有其他超主的契约
由其他帝国每个受到§H终末光环§!影响的恒星系对我国的评价降低：§R-15§!
tooltips.en:
Replaces the domains of all known patrons with the §REnd of the Cycle§!.
We will be granted at least 50 years to consume the galaxy in the §HAura of the End§!. If we succeed, the game ends.
§RDo not do this.§!

Technologies Gained:
£society£['technology:tech_psionic_aura']
£society£['technology:tech_aura_intensification']
Tech progress gained on all ['concept_psionic_components']: §G+10%§!

Revert the Accords of all other Patrons
Other empires' Opinion of us for each of their systems affected by the §HAura of the End§!: §R-15§!

label.en: Exit the Shroud and try to forget.

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

descriptions.zh:
我们的命运与§R轮回之终末§!绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。

只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
descriptions.en:
Our fate is bound to the §REnd of the Cycle§!; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.

Should we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

options.script:
name = shroud.4140.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.4140.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh:
解锁['concept_total_war']§H宣战理由§!
其他帝国对我国的评价：§R-200§!
tooltips.en:
Gain access to the ['concept_total_war'] §HCasus Belli§!
Other empires' Opinion of us: §R-200§!

descriptions.zh: 随着§R终末光环§!渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳§R轮回之终末§!的。
descriptions.en: As the §RAura of the End§! suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the §REnd of the Cycle§!.

descriptions.zh: 随着§R终末光环§!渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们的遥邻很快就向我们发难。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳§R轮回之终末§!的。
descriptions.en: As the §RAura of the End§! suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the §REnd of the Cycle§!.

descriptions.zh: 受超主意愿的启发，我们发明了一种消耗能量和物质来充能光环的新方法。可以献祭这个宇宙的物质来推进终末。
descriptions.en: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.

label.en: We must do all that is necessary.

options.script:
name = shroud.4145.a
custom_tooltip = shroud.4145.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh:
其他帝国对我国的评价：§R-500§!
解锁法令：
    —['edict:annihilation_of_matter', 物质湮灭]
    —['edict:annihilation_of_energy', 能量湮灭][GetDimensionalCollapseEdictGain]
tooltips.en:
Other empires' Opinion of us: §R-500§!
Unlocks Edicts:
    - ['edict:annihilation_of_matter', Annihilation of Matter]
    - ['edict:annihilation_of_energy', Annihilation of Energy][GetDimensionalCollapseEdictGain]

descriptions.zh:
我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。

如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
descriptions.en:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种称为§H“灵能光环”§!的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

这种光环现在也在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
descriptions.en:
Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed §H'Psionic Auras'§!, on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sources, we have yet to confirm whether they pose a threat or not.

Such an Aura has now been detected in the §H[from.GetName]§! system, which might encroach within our borders if it continues to spread.

descriptions.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!或许知道如何反制其效果。
descriptions.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! may know methods of counteracting its effects.

label.zh: 我们很快就会知道它有什么作用了。
label.en: We might know their effects soon enough.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听§H虚境§!中的回声得知，这一现象是由§H[fromfrom.GetName]§!的灵能活动引起的。
descriptions.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the §H[from.GetName]§! system. Listening to echoes within the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the §H[fromfrom.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听§H虚境§!中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
descriptions.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the §H[from.GetName]§! system. Listening to echoes within the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

descriptions.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出§H灵能光环§!的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
descriptions.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a §HPsionic Aura§!, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

descriptions.zh: 它被称为§H“灵能光环”§!，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
descriptions.en: Termed a §H'Psionic Aura'§!, it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

descriptions.zh: 由于我们与[fromfrom.GetName]的关系[GetLessThanRivalAdj]良好，我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
descriptions.en: Given our [GetLessThanRivalAdj]favorable relations with the [fromfrom.GetName], we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

descriptions.zh: 据[GetTelepathPlural]的说法，它能释放[GetBenevolentRivalAdj]的意志，因此我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
descriptions.en: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

descriptions.zh: 我们是时候团结一致阻止灵能天灾了。
descriptions.en: Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

descriptions.zh: 如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H泽珞§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
descriptions.en: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §Hzro§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

descriptions.zh:
严峻的时刻到了。尽管我们竭尽全力，§R轮回之终末§!还是到来了。它在群星之间四处恐怖地显灵……

我们是时候团结一致阻止灵能天灾了。
descriptions.en:
These are grave times. Despite our efforts, the §REnd of the Cycle§! is upon us. Its dreadful manifestation stalks among the stars...

Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

descriptions.zh:
你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们的使命是保护大家免受§H虚境§!以及所有传播其恶意效应者的威胁。我们信仰心灵神圣不可侵犯，巩固星系抵御灵能。

我们根据灵能传感器读数判断出你们不会造成这种威胁。太好了。我们很乐意提供帮助，保护你不受伤害。

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H泽珞§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
descriptions.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Our mission is to protect against the menace of the §HShroud§! and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §Hzro§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

descriptions.zh:
欢迎回来。[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

我们的灵能传感器读数清晰。你们没有被§H虚境§!玷污。很好，很好……

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H泽珞§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
descriptions.en:
Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.

Our psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the §HShroud§!. Good, good...

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §Hzro§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

label.en: What can be done about §YPsionic Auras§!?

label.zh: 我们知道一个不错的灵能目标……
label.en: We know of a good psionic target...

tooltips.zh: 雇佣[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural]去袭击一个已知的灵能帝国。
tooltips.en: Pay the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.species.GetNamePlural] to raid a Psionic Empire we know of.

label.en: We need help with £crime£ §Y[GetCrimeDeviancy]§! among us.

label.zh: 我们可以借用你们的士兵。
label.en: We could make use of your soldiers.

label.zh: 你们愿意派一位§Y督查§!来吗？
label.en: Would you be willing to send us a §Ywarden§!?

label.zh: 和我们说说轮回之终末。
label.en: We want to discuss the End of the Cycle.

label.zh: 作为你们的§Y赞助方§!，我们有个提案。
label.en: As your §Yfounding patron§!, we have a proposal.

tooltips.zh: 太空城邦的§Y赞助者§!可以帮助他们发展或征用一支已经雇佣的舰队。
tooltips.en: The §YPatron§! of an enclave can help them develop or requisition a fleet that is already hired.

default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh:
抑制§H灵能光环§!主要有两种方法。

在行星上建造§H灵能抑制器§!可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。

更强大的解决方法是§H虚境封印§!。这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解灵能光环，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。
descriptions.en:
There are two principal methods of suppressing §HPsionic Auras§!.

Building a §HPsionic Suppressor§! on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An even more powerful solution is a §HShroud Seal§!. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

descriptions.zh:
乐意效劳。数据将会直接传过去。

愿这些科技在光环浩劫中给你带去和平。
descriptions.en:
Gladly. The data will be transmitted forthwith.

May these technologies bring you peace from the auric scourge.

descriptions.zh:
是这样吗？好吧，他们还在用灵能荼毒这个星系，我们就永远不得享受真的安宁……

有针对性的袭击可以表达我们对这种危险行为的反对。而在你们的经济支持下，我们愿意执行这次行动。

如果你们同意，就告诉我们目标吧。
descriptions.en:
Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...

A targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we are willing to conduct such an operation.

Let us know the target, if you agree.

descriptions.zh:
啊，好的。我们知道他们在实践灵能了。展示力量是正当的。

感谢你的支持。行动将会很快开始。
descriptions.en:
Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.

Thank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.

descriptions.zh: 一支来自§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§!的军事舰队正在逼近我们的国境！拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。他们正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
descriptions.en: A military fleet from the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]§! is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

descriptions.zh: 一支来自此前未知的军事势力的舰队正在逼近我们的国境！拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。他们自称§H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
descriptions.en: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. Identifying themselves as the §H[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!, they are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

descriptions.zh:
棒极了。把泽珞委托给我们，可以对这种强大而被大规模滥用的物质进行关键的研究——这项研究将使整个星系受益。

这也是我们以高于星系标准的价格购买的原因。
descriptions.en:
Excellent. Entrusting us with zro enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.

This is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

descriptions.zh: 感谢你的贡献。
descriptions.en: Thank you for your contribution.

descriptions.zh:
那就让我们来提供一些有用的§Y思想警察§!，这可以在[GetCriminalDeviant]意图演变成实际行为之前将其探测到。

他们使用一种专门开发的安全灵能替代方法，以科学技术来监测人群的认知活动。他们提供对精神状态的洞见，而不使用§H虚境§!的危险能量。
descriptions.en:
Then let us provide you with an effective §YThought Police§!, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.

Their methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices, using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity. They provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the §HShroud§!.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

tooltips.zh: 解锁一个£decision£§Y殖民地决议§!：§Y思想警察§!
tooltips.en: Unlocks one £decision£ §YColony Decision§!: §YThought Police§!

descriptions.zh: 很好。我相信你会发现这种方法非常地有效。
descriptions.en: Excellent. I think you will find their methods quite efficacious.

descriptions.zh:
确实。通过合作我们发现了你们军事部署战略有一些可以改进的方面。

当然，我们这么说并不是有意侮辱；不过是术业有专攻罢了。如果你们能给出足够的价码，我们很荣幸能和如此有价值的客户就此合作。
descriptions.en:
Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.

We mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We would be honored to assist such a valued partner in this matter, should you provide us adequate compensation.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 很好。我们的舰队支援运作会立刻开始。
descriptions.en: Very good. Our fleet support operations will commence at once.

descriptions.zh:
您好，尊贵的合作伙伴。

我们的舰队后勤运作协助协议已经到期。如果您考虑的话，我们非常愿意继续合作。
descriptions.en:
Greetings, valued partner.

Our contract to assist in the logistical operations of your fleets has expired. We would be more than willing to continue this partnership, should you deem it worth your while.

options.script:
name = shroud.4267.b
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的灵督突击队是非常强大的震慑部队。他们有能应对各种威胁的装备，但对使用灵能的对手特别有效。

我觉得你会发现物有所值的。
descriptions.en:
Our Assault Wardens make excellent shock troopers. They are equipped to tackle diverse threats, but are especially effective against psionic opponents.

We think you will find them worth their price.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

tooltips.zh: 招募一支§Y灵督突击队§!陆军，乘坐运输舰运抵首都恒星系。
tooltips.en: Enlist an §YAssault Wardens§! army, arriving by Transport Ship at our capital system.

descriptions.zh: 你走运了；我们正好有一支连队准备好部署。就等着他们的运输船立即到达吧。
descriptions.en: You are in luck; we already have a company ready for deployment. Expect the arrival of their transport ship presently.

descriptions.zh:
我们非常乐意。

高效的领导是战胜§H虚境§!的关键，我们的督查们正精于利用严格的管理来压制灵能活动。
descriptions.en:
We would be more than willing.

Effective leadership is key to combating the §HShroud§!, and our wardens are well-versed in suppressing psionic activity through firm governance.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

tooltips.zh: 我们将雇佣一位等级5的灵督督管专员。
tooltips.en: We will hire a Level 5 Mindwarden Commissioner.

descriptions.zh: 明智的决定。愿他们的管理能保障你们的人民在未来的岁月里的安全。
descriptions.en: A wise decision. May their stewardship keep your population safe for years to come.

descriptions.zh: 说实话，这是个严峻的东西。星系中没有比§R轮回之终末§!更大的灾难了。
descriptions.en: A grave matter, indeed. There is no greater scourge in the galaxy than that of the §REnd of the Cycle§!.

label.en: What is the §REnd of the Cycle§!!?

options.script:
name = shroud.4290.b
response_text = shroud.4290.b.response
is_dialog_only = yes

label.zh: 我们要如何击败§R最终清算§!？

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 愿你们对这场巨大威胁凯旋而归。它威胁到了居住在这个星系中的所有人的生死存亡。
descriptions.en: May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.

descriptions.zh:
我们开发出了一种算法可以增强你们对§R最终清算§!的进攻能力。这可以提升你们武器系统在对特定灵能实体时的效率。

在目前阶段，这份代码的每次改进都需要大量重构，才能与各个军事基础设施兼容。因此，这是一项高级服务，但我们认为您能认可它的物超所值。
descriptions.en:
We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the §RReckoning§!. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.

In its current state, each deployment of the code requires extensive refactoring for compatibility with individual military infrastructures. This is therefore a premium service, but we think you will find it worth the outlay.

descriptions.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle]§Y[root.GetName]§!离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

§L“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”§!

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
descriptions.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] §Y[root.GetName]§! has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

§L"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them."§!

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_councilor = yes }

descriptions.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle]§Y[root.GetName]§!离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

§L“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”§!

万幸的是，除了搬离了[root.GetHisHer]自己的工作场所以外，[root.GetName]对领导层没有造成其他任何的扰乱。
descriptions.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] §Y[root.GetName]§! has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

§L"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them."§!

Thankfully, aside from vacating [root.GetHisHer] workspace, [root.GetName] did not cause any other disruptions to leadership.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_councilor = no }

tooltips.zh: §Y[root.GetName]§!离开了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: §Y[root.GetName]§! leaves our empire.

descriptions.zh:
你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们最初对与你们“物现引擎”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓§H“虚境”§!的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。

我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。
descriptions.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

We were initially concerned by reports of your 'Materiality Engines'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising development for non-psionic exploitation of the so-called §H'Shroud'§!.

We encourage your continued deployment of this technology, and look forward to working with you in the future.

options.script:
name = ACKNOWLEDGED
custom_tooltip = mindwarden_opinion_materiality_engine_tt

tooltips.zh: 评价：£opinion£§G+$@mindwarden_opinion_materiality_engine|0$§!
tooltips.en: Opinion: £opinion£ §G+$@mindwarden_opinion_materiality_engine|0$§!

descriptions.zh:
我谨代表[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

根据我们灵能传感器的读数，整个[Root.GetName]已经无可挽回地被§H虚境§!玷污了。

你们的所作所为是在自掘坟墓——我们不介意帮你们一铲子。
descriptions.en:
I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the §HShroud§!.

Your actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.

label.zh: 你们为什么这么害怕虚境？
label.en: Why do you fear the Shroud?

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们不害怕虚境，更不害怕它的走狗，因为我们知道如何对付这些东西。

我不指望你们——这被虚境影响得失心疯了的社会——理解一丝一毫。
descriptions.en:
We do not fear it, nor its corrupted agents, as we know how to fight it.

I would not expect you - a society maddened by its influence - to understand.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh: 难道用灵能荼毒星系还不够吗？
descriptions.en: Was it not enough to poison the galaxy with psionics?

descriptions.zh: 我们是维护星系秩序的力量；攻击我们有什么好处？我们不会坐视你的好战行为。
descriptions.en: We are a force for order in this galaxy; what benefit is there in attacking us? We shall not idly tolerate your belligerence.

descriptions.zh: 在你们确认无条件停止敌对行为之前，我们没什么可谈的。
descriptions.en: Until you confirm the unconditional cessation of hostile attacks, we have nothing to discuss.

options.script:
name = END_TRANSMISSION
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们知道你们和§H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!的那些交易。你们这种行为不仅是在纵容他们的错误，更是在帮助§H虚境§!感染传播。

只要你们还在与他们合作，我们就不会提供任何服务。
descriptions.en:
We are aware of your dealings with the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!. Your actions not only legitimize their wrongdoing, but help spread the infection of the §HShroud§!.

We will not render you any services while you remain their collaborators.

options.script:
name = DOTDOTDOT
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H在他们的设施遭到摧毁后，我们至今无法与[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]再次取得联系。

打开他们的通讯频道，我们只能听到宇宙的虚空寂静。§!
descriptions.en:
§HWe have not been able to reestablish contact with the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] since the destruction of their facility.

When we listen to their channel, we hear only the empty quietude of space.§!

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!现已不复存在。他们不该再继续传播那种关于所谓§H虚境§!危险的无知教条，他们空间站的灵能衰减器现在已经是一堆破铜烂铁了。
descriptions.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! is no more. They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the §HShroud§!, and their station's psionic attenuators are now debris.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!现已不复存在。尽管他们所鄙夷的东西对我们毫无意义，但他们对§H“虚境”§!的十字军式的讨伐代表了一种不应该在我们星系中存在的伪科学教条主义。
descriptions.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! is no more. Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the §H'Shroud'§! represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我们的胜利是巨大的成功，甚至还可以从他们空间站的残骸打捞大量的资源。
descriptions.en: Our victory was doubly successful, as we were also able to salvage a sizable amount of resources from the wreckage of their station.

descriptions.zh: 我们获悉[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!不复存在了。该灵督城邦无法抵御§H[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]§!的猛烈攻击，他们的空间站化作碎片，没有找到任何幸存者。
descriptions.en: We have received reports that the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system is no more. This Mindwarden Enclave was unable to withstand an onslaught by the §H[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]§!, which reduced their station to debris and left no known survivors.

descriptions.zh: 现在星系不用再遭受他们的反灵能十字军行为的骚扰了——只要没有人再冒出来扮演这个角色。
descriptions.en: The galaxy is now free from the torment of their anti-psionic crusade - as long as no one emerges to take their place.

descriptions.zh: 之后没有他们提供反灵能服务的日子，这个星系只得勉强应付了。
descriptions.en: The galaxy will have to make do without their anti-psionic services for the time being.

label.zh: 和§H世界之喰煞§!签订契约。
label.en: Form a Covenant with the §HEater of Worlds§!.

tooltips.zh: §Y某些代价终将要付出。§!
tooltips.en: §YThere will be a price to pay.§!

tooltips.zh: 开始事件链：§Y世界之喰煞§!
tooltips.en: Begins the Event Chain: §YThe Eater of Worlds§!

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

label.en: We will forge our own path.

descriptions.zh:
完成了。我们与§H世界之喰煞§!签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。

[GetEaterCovenantFormedDesc]

随着我们纽带的建立，喰煞索要走了贡品：我们一座城市的全部人口突然消失了。这个代价并不大——除非喰煞还会饿。
descriptions.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §HEater of Worlds§!. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

[GetEaterCovenantFormedDesc]

As we formed our bond, the Eater claimed its tribute: the entire population of one of our cities suddenly disappeared. A small price to pay - unless the Eater gets hungry again.

descriptions.zh:
完成了。我们与§H世界之喰煞§!签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。

我们社会的变化已经可以观测。我们的军事单元无比专注于战斗；在和平时期，他们也必须坚持进行严苛战斗模拟，否则将出现非必要进攻性。

随着我们纽带的建立，喰煞索要走了贡品：我们一座城市的全部人口突然消失了。这个代价并不大——除非喰煞还会饿。
descriptions.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §HEater of Worlds§!. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

Changes in our society are already detectable. Our military units are ever more focused on battle; in peacetime, they must be kept engaged in taxing combat simulations, lest their restlessness turn to savagery.

As we formed our bond, the Eater claimed its tribute: the entire population of one of our cities suddenly disappeared. A small price to pay - unless the Eater gets hungry again.

自从与§H世界之喰煞§!签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]确定，有了这一正式承诺就能主动地利用超主所提供的力量，增强我们的舰队和灵能光环。
descriptions.en:
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HEater of Worlds§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

label.en: We will forge our own path.

descriptions.zh:
我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是§H渴求之器具§!，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

§H只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。§!

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
descriptions.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is the §HInstrument of Desire§! and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

§HIf we will only accept it into our mainframes.§!

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

descriptions.zh:
完成了。我们与§H渴求之器具§!签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。

这笔买卖的代价已经可见了。我们等待着无上产出的黄金时代到来，子个体的基础需求也提高了。各地的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始需要各种各样非必要物资——这是我们的一个新的经济负担。

这就是我们纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，器具最强的庇佑还没到来。
descriptions.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §HInstrument of Desire§!. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

The cost of the bargain is already detectable. As we await the promised golden age of matchless output, the basic necessities of our drones have increased. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] everywhere now require a range of inessential goods - a new burden on our economy.

Such is the price of our bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Instrument's greatest blessings are yet to come.

descriptions.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是§H生命之织缕§!，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以适应、变化、改进、演化的方向。

§H只要我们愿意将其纳入组成。§!

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
descriptions.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, the §HComposer of Strands§!, regards our mechanical forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be adapted, changed. Improved. Upgraded.

§HIf we will only take it into our components.§!

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的思维中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是§H生命之织缕§!，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以生长、变化、改进、演化的方向。

§H只要我们愿意将其纳入肉身。§!

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
descriptions.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the minds of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, the §HComposer of Strands§!, regards our organic forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be grown, changed. Improved. Evolved.

§HIf we will only take it into our flesh.§!

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

descriptions.zh:
完成了。我们与§H生命之织缕§!签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[Root.GetName]§!。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的测试回路中检测到了分子结构的异常模式，简直像许多代的系统升级在一夜之间发生。很显然我们放弃了一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形体的控制，我们的超主现在可以随意将其改变。

这种小小的牺牲就是我们新结纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，织缕最强的庇佑还没到来。
descriptions.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §HComposer of Strands§!. Its will courses through the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

Our [GetScientistPlural] have already detected anomalous patterns in the molecular structure of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] test circuits, as though many generations of system upgrades had occurred overnight. It is clear that we have relinquished some control over the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form, which our patron is now free to change at will.

This is a small sacrifice for our newfound bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Composer's greatest blessings are yet to come.

自从与§H生命之织缕§!签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。

Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the §HComposer of Strands§!. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

descriptions.zh:
当我们抵达虚境时、我们通灵者的内心响起了一阵齐声。最开始只是轻柔的低语，随后变为强烈的刺耳声，一千道声音开始齐声讲述。

这些声音自称§H虚空之低语§!。合唱中的每个个体都感应到：秘密的低语、空置之御座、人偶的大师，有许多许多的存在都加入了低语的合唱。祂——祂们——宣称通晓所有凡人向另一个凡人低语的秘密知识，并且愿意和我们分享这些知识……

§H只要我们同意让祂们进入我们的意识。§!

一个微不足道的代价，就像祂们宣称的那样。我们甚至难以察觉祂们的存在。

祂们的语气中透露着急切。
descriptions.en:
As we reach into the Shroud, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Individual members of the chorus make themselves known: the Susurrus of Secrets, the Vacant Throne, the Master of Puppets - there are so many of them, all joined in the chorus of the Whisperers. It - they - claim to be privy to all knowledge whispered in secrecy from one mortal to another, and offer to share some of these secrets with us...

§HIf we will only allow them into our consciousness.§!

A trifling price, they assure us. We will barely even notice their presence.

There is an urgency to their tone.

descriptions.zh:
完成了。我们与§H虚空之低语§!签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个§H[root.GetName]§!。

新超主的影响出现得非常迅速。随着我们的集体等待着隐秘知识的汇入，我们感觉到了自己的思想分支成了不同的模式。[GetNetworkName]的稳态和谐被内心越来越不统一的声音所覆盖。

这就是强大纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，低语最强的庇佑还没到来。我们与这种强大的灵能实体直接交流毫无疑问非常值得。
descriptions.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §HWhisperers in the Void§!. Their will courses through the §H[root.GetName]§!.

The influence of our new patron has taken hold swiftly. As our collective awaits an influx of hidden knowledge, we sense our thoughts splintering into divergent patterns. The steady harmony of the [GetNetworkName] is overlaid with a growing discord of inner voices.

Such is the price of this powerful bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Whisperers' greatest blessings are yet to come. Our direct communion with such a magnificent psionic entity will surely have been worth it.

descriptions.zh:
完成了。我们与§R轮回之终末§!签订了契约。我们一达成交易，[GetTelepathPlural]便齐声说：§R“时日已到。”§!

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经§H虚境§!的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。

我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。
descriptions.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the §REnd of the Cycle§!. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: §R"THE END BEGINS."§!

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the §HShroud§! roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听§H虚境§!中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
descriptions.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the §H[from.GetName]§! system. Listening to echoes within the §HShroud§!, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

descriptions.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出§H灵能光环§!的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
descriptions.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a §HPsionic Aura§!, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

descriptions.zh: 它被称为§H“灵能光环”§!，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
descriptions.en: Termed a §H'Psionic Aura'§!, it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

descriptions.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
descriptions.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

descriptions.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Such a §H'Psionic Aura'§!, so-called due to its theorized origin, has now been detected in the §H[from.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the §HShroud§!.

descriptions.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，即便§H虚境§!也感受到了怪异的不安，仿佛它的力量在安静的恐惧中颤抖。

descriptions.zh:
§R轮回之终末§!降临了。

终末光环吞噬了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系的沦陷，一道无法计量的能量潮爆发而出。不同维度之间的帷幕短暂消失了，虚境的灵能力突然被一整个驱逐到可接触现实中。

所有的有意识众生，无论是生物还是机械体都被抹除了。所有的行星都变成了荒芜的空壳。即便恒星也熄灭了最后一道光芒。

尽管如此，在最后一刻，我们所能感受到的只是脑海中的一个心声……

§R“此为万终之末。”§!
descriptions.en:
The §REnd of the Cycle§! is upon us.

The Aura of the End has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

§R"THE END OF ENDS."§!

tooltips.zh:

We ended the cycle.

§YThe galaxy is destroyed.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们的怀疑得到了确认。[first_neighbor.GetAdjective]与[second_neighbor.GetAdjective]的文明证实，他们在正式进行外交之前，曾通过非正式渠道开展过联系。

这些§H派系§!如今从我们的阴影中现身，承认了他们的存在。它们被称为§H帷幕§!、§H假面舞会§!以及§H大舞§!。这群曾经的秘密组织如今正公开请求与我们展开正式对话。

至于它们想要什么，以及它们是如何知晓所知之事，我们也许永远无法真正知道。但为了我们的最佳利益，也许我们应当遵循他们的命令行事。
descriptions.en:
Our suspicions have been justified. The [first_neighbor.GetAdjective] and [second_neighbor.GetAdjective] civilizations have confirmed they have been contacted through unofficial channels before more formal communications began.

These §HFactions§! now emerge from our own shadows and acknowledge their existence. Known as §HThe Curtain§!, §HThe Masquerade§! and §HThe Grand Dance§!, these once-secret organizations are now openly requesting formal dialogue with us.

What they want, and how they know what they know, may never truly be understood by us. It may be in our best interest to operate within their demands.

tooltips.zh:
§Y秘密结社派系§!将很快出现：
    §H帷幕§!
    §H假面舞会§!
    §H大舞§!
tooltips.en:
§YSecret Society Factions§! will soon emerge:
    §HThe Curtain§!
    §HThe Masquerade§!
    §HThe Grand Dance§!

descriptions.zh:
在我们之中，有些人暗中操纵着外交事务。现在我们怀疑，他们的触角已不仅仅局限于我们的母星。

尽管我们才刚开始探索星空，却以惊人的速度与其他生命形式建立了联系。这似乎不仅仅是巧合。我们怀疑，这些星际关系源于几个秘密的§H派系§!的幕后运作，而这些派系已经深深扎根于我们的社会之中。

也许当我们对这些生物了解更多之后，隐匿于暗影中的势力自会显露真容。
descriptions.en:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This seems like more than coincidence. We suspect that these interstellar relationships originate behind the closed doors of several secret §HFactions§! that have deeply embedded themselves within our society.

Perhaps once we know more about these beings, those within our shadows will reveal themselves.

label.zh: 他们是支持我们？还是反对我们？
label.en: Are they with us, or against us?

options.script: name = shroud.5013.a

titles.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光

descriptions.zh:
我们被骗了。

我们的情报人员截获了来自§H[from.GetName]§!的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。

他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。
descriptions.en:
We were fooled.

Our intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the §H[from.GetName]§!. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.

They have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done. News of their duplicity has spread rapidly, adversely affecting the reputation of the [from.GetName] throughout the galaxy.

titles.zh: 代理人战争准备遭曝光

descriptions.zh:
虽然我们成功挑起了冲突，但行动并未完全按照计划进行。我们的一个特工的通讯被截获，导致我们暗中的行动被所有相关方知晓。

我们试图辩解，但毫无用处。此事件不仅损害了我们与参战方的关系，还在星系范围内玷污了我们的声誉。
descriptions.en:
Though we managed to incite a conflict, the operation did not go entirely to plan. One of our agents' communications was intercepted, revealing our covert actions to all parties involved.

Our attempts to explain away the affair were ineffective. Not only has this event harmed our relationships with the belligerents, but the scandal has damaged our reputation on a galactic scale.

Our attempts to explain away the affair were ineffective. This event has significantly harmed our relationships with the belligerents.

tooltips.zh: 卷入§Y代理人战争§!的帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-200§!
tooltips.en: Empires involved in the §YProxy War§! have their opinion of us changed by: §R-200§!

descriptions.zh:
与一个既无法定义也无法理解的实体间的空灵联系……我们一直都了然于心。

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

在我们刚有历史记录以来，这个神秘的事物便一直存在于此。显然，祂选中了我们……但是，原因不得而知。

我们应该如何描述这种[This.GetSensation]呢？
descriptions.en:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.

By what name should we call this [This.GetSensation]?

descriptions.zh:
在历史长河中，被称为§H[GetChosenPatron]§!的难以名状的存在一直与我们同在。如今，宽广的星系等待着我们，我们愈发深刻地在[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中[GetFeelLoc]到祂的存在。

祂徘徊不去，招徕着我们。随着距离的接近，我们第一次注意到[GetMindLogicLoc]深处这个神秘空间的真实轮廓。[GetChosenPatron]呼唤着我们进去，，用未知的原理优化着我们的参数。

终于，我们理解了如何依靠自己的意志造访这片虚幻领域。
descriptions.en:
Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the §H[GetChosenPatron]§! has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never before.

It lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own [GetMindLogicLoc]. The [GetChosenPatron] beckons us in, streamlining our parameters in line with some as yet unknown principles.

Finally, we understand how to visit this ethereal domain of our own volition.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_robot_empire = yes }

获得该实体的§Y调和度§!：$@chosen_patron_attunement_gift|0G$
可以通过§Y通讯§!菜单访问§Y虚境§!面板。

Gain §YAttunement§! with this entity: $@chosen_patron_attunement_gift|0G$
The §YShroud§! panel is accessible via the §YContacts§! menu.

descriptions.zh:
虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。

虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。

在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。§H[GetChosenPatron]§!正等待着我们。

§H舒展。包裹。拓展。§!

在这无数实体的漩涡中，它的清晰是一种承诺。
descriptions.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined minds, we sense it clearly enough to explore with purpose.

On the other side, our efforts have not gone unnoticed. The §H[GetChosenPatron]§! awaits us.

§HUNFURL. ENWRAP. EXPAND.§!

In this maelstrom of countless entities, its clarity is a promise.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = the_composer_of_strands_as_chosen_patron }

label.en: We seek to further our §Yattunement§! to a Patron.

关于§Y灵能光环§!你们知道多少。
label.en: What can you tell us about §YPsionic Auras§!.

label.zh: 我们希望扩展超主的§Y灵域§!。
label.en: We wish to expand our Patron's §Ydomain§!.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
在这件事上我们已经竭尽全力。已经没有我们能帮你们引荐的实体了。

我们赞许你们的努力……很少有人灵潜至§H虚境§!如此深层的灵域还能保持心智如此健全。
descriptions.en:
We have reached the limits of our abilities to assist you in this regard. There are no further entities we are capable of guiding your thoughts to.

We commend you for your efforts... few delve so deeply into the domains of the §HShroud§! and retain such soundness of mind.

descriptions.zh:
对没有准备的人而言，在§H虚境§!的灵域交流十分凶险。

我们可以引导你们完成这个过程，但是要注意：有些居住在里面的实体如果迎接入人的意识里是非常危险的。
descriptions.en:
Communing in the domains of the §HShroud§! has proven to be a perilous endeavor for the unprepared.

We can guide you through this process, though take heed: The entities that dwell within can be very dangerous to welcome into one's mind.

我们可以用一些§Y泽珞§!来支持这项行动。

default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
你们与§H虚境§!的意志调和得越深，你们的心智就会变得越强大。

你们想要和哪一位实体增进调和度呢？
descriptions.en:
The more deeply you attune to the §HShroud's§! will, the more powerful your mind will become.

With which entity do you seek to further your attunement with?

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
噢，没错……§H虚境§!，它蕴藏着无数秘密，深深埋藏在思绪与梦境的帷幕之下——只要懂得如何去探寻，就能发现它们。

我们只能引领你去接触我们已揭示的洞见。在那里，或许能见到全新而强大的技术不断绽放，但长路漫漫，你仍需前进。

只需记住这一点：我们的灵能巫必须全身心投入这项领航的任务。而对于他们指引之外的事物……就不是我们所能掌控的了。
descriptions.en:
Oh yes... the §HShroud§! It is teeming with secrets, layered deep beneath veils of thought and dream - if one knows how to seek them.

We can only guide you to the insights we have uncovered. From there, new and formidable technologies may bloom, but the path is yours to walk.

Just know this: our coven of telepaths must devote themselves wholly to this task. What lies beyond their guidance... is not ours to control.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们可以用一些§Y泽珞§!来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with §YZro§!.

label.zh: 我我们可以用一些§Y星界丝缕§!来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with §YAstral Threads§!.

default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H虚境§!再一次证明了世上一切本就命定。

我们的密会本要为你们寻求的洞见已经被你自己通过钻研努力发现了。你们的努力值得赞赏，而我们在这个方面也没有什么能帮助你们的了。
descriptions.en:
The §HShroud§! proves once again that there are no coincidences.

The insight our conclave sought for you has been discovered through your own delving efforts. While we applaud your efforts, we cannot help you further in this regard.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
称赞你们。你们对灵能光环的认知已经超越了我们。

你们的存在将§H虚境§!中的一种强大的肌理显化到我们的现实中。你们肯定知道着什么秘密……
descriptions.en:
We commend you. Your knowledge of Psionic Auras already surpasses our own.

Your very presence manifests a formidable texture of the §HShroud§! into this reality. What secrets you must know...

descriptions.zh:
你们的灵能光环是通过与§H虚境§!的调和度来显化的。它影响着周遭的世界，充满了意图。在对话的过程中，我们的巫会已经感知到你们的意图：其中带着§H贪婪§!之色。

你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。
descriptions.en:
Your Psionic Aura is your attunement to the §HShroud§! made manifest. It affects all around you, and is filled with intent. Our coven senses the manner of yours as we speak: a §Hravenous§! texture.

The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

descriptions.zh: 将§H虚境§!显化到物理世界的方法是需要严守的秘密，这一点连我们也无可指教。要释放灵能光环需要自己深入许多灵域。与最喜欢的实体调和，这项知识就会让你豁然开朗。
descriptions.en: The capability to manifest the §HShroud§! in the physical realm is a closely guarded secret, and one that even we cannot teach. To unleash one's Psionic Aura requires a personal journey into its many domains. Attune more heavily to a favored entity, and this knowledge will clarify in your mind.

descriptions.zh:
§Y灵能光环§!的扩增需要极高程度的专注来维持。

我们愿意在此事上提供帮助，但需要提供一些材料助力冥想。
descriptions.en:
The amplification of §YPsionic Auras§! requires great levels of concentration to maintain.

We are willing to assist you in this matter, but will require the contribution of materials to fuel our meditation.
