default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们灵能使关于扩增你们§Y灵能光环§!强度的协议已经到期。

为了继续保持冥想，我们需要更多的资源。是否乐意成交？
descriptions.en:
Our telepaths have reached the end of our agreement to amplify the strength of your §YPsionic Aura§!.

In order for us to continue our meditations, we will require further resources. Is this within your interests?

label.zh: 我们将会提供§H星界丝缕§!。

options.script:
name = shroud.5327.b
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
如你们所知，在你们的周围显化你们自己的§Y灵能光环§!相当容易。但要把光环投射到其他地方，可就完全不是一回事了。

我们知道一种方法……

先进科技和灵能之间的相似之处比人们想象的要多。这也许说明了某种更根本的事实。无论如何，我们知道一种可以传导你们意志的装置。只要与其频率调谐之后，就能把它用作一个补充心智，跨越极远的距离。

我们的这种设计完全可以安装在任何一座适用的恒星基地上。你们对这感兴趣吗？
descriptions.en:
As you know, manifesting your §YPsionic Aura§! in your immediate surroundings is quite easily done. To project one's aura somewhere else, however, is another matter entirely.

We know of a way...

There are more similarities between advanced technology and psionics than one would think. Perhaps this speaks to a greater fundamental truth. In any case, we know of a device that can serve as a conduit for your will. Once you become attuned to its frequencies, it will act as a supplementary mind even across great distances.

Our designs are fully capable of being installed in any suitable starbase. Does such a machine interest you?

label.zh: 我们可以提供§H星界丝缕§!。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向§H虚境§!的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
descriptions.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. The path you are inviting is a path to the §HShroud§!.

We do not make this offer lightly. We trust that you will let us know when you are ready.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。

然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
descriptions.en:
Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.

However, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be done responsibly, so our offer stands at that.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“§H虚境封印§!”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
descriptions.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These '§HShroud Seal§!' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will have no further dealings with you.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
custom_tooltip = shroudwalkers_opinion_shroud_seals_tt

tooltips.zh: 评价：£opinion£§R$@shroudwalkers_opinion_shroud_seals|0$§!
tooltips.en: Opinion: £opinion£ §R$@shroudwalkers_opinion_shroud_seals|0$§!

descriptions.zh: 如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H泽珞§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
descriptions.en: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §Hzro§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

descriptions.zh:
欢迎回来，督察朋友。§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!很重视我们的持续合作。

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的§H泽珞§!需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
descriptions.en:
Welcome back, fellow wardens. The §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! values our continued cooperation.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have §Hzro§! to dispose of, let us assist you.

descriptions.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：第一个§H灵督城邦§!成立了。从今天起，§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!将肩负起与§H虚境§!还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从§H泽珞§!处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
descriptions.en:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of the first §HMindwarden Enclave§! is complete. From today, the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! shall carry on the vital work of combating the §HShroud§! and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from §Hzro§! disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.

descriptions.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：我们的§H灵督城邦§!成立了。从今天起，§H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§!将肩负起与§H虚境§!还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从§H泽珞§!处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
descriptions.en:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our §HMindwarden Enclave§! is complete. From today, the §H[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]§! shall carry on the vital work of combating the §HShroud§! and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from §Hzro§! disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.

descriptions.zh: 我们永远感谢您对[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的贡献。只要灵能威胁还在肆虐，我们的关系便不可动摇。
descriptions.en: We are forever thankful for your contribution to the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]. For as long as the psionic threat remains, may our bond be unwavering.

descriptions.zh: 你大可放心，下一笔利润分红也将及时支付。
descriptions.en: You can trust that your next profit-share payment will be delivered in a timely fashion.

descriptions.zh: 请知悉。我们乐与[root.GetName]维持紧密的合作关系；我们的历史和目标永远紧密相连。
descriptions.en: Please make it known. We are glad to maintain close cooperation with the [root.GetName]; our histories and aims are forever bound.

label.zh: 我们希望帮你们升级太空城邦。
label.en: We want to help expand your enclave.

label.zh: 我们希望能和你们共享科技。
label.en: We want to share our technology with you.

label.zh: 我们希望能雇佣一支你们的§Y舰队§!为我们服务。
label.en: We wish to hire a §Yfleet§! for our own purposes.

tooltips.zh: 接管这个太空城邦的§Y灵督舰队§!，时长为10年。
tooltips.en: Take control of the §YMindwarden fleet§! of this enclave for 10 years.

label.zh: 我们打算§Y管理§!我们租借的舰队。
label.en: We wish to §Ymanage§! our rented fleet.

tooltips.zh: 取消或延长你的§Y灵督舰队§!合约。
tooltips.en: Cancel or prolong our §YMindwarden fleet§! contract.

label.zh: 我希望提升我们的灵督城邦容量。
label.en: We wish to increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 有了更多资金，我们就能大幅度扩大行动。我们可以提升舰队的数量和质量，招募更多的科研人员来开发心灵防护科技。最终，整个星系都将从您的慷慨解囊中收益。
descriptions.en: With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole galaxy would benefit from your patronage.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须对诡计多端的灵能威胁保持警惕。您的慷慨捐赠将使我们能够大大扩大业务规模以应对这种挑战。
descriptions.en: We must remain vigilant against the ever-changing threat of psionics. Your generous donation would allow us to significantly scale up our operations to meet this challenge.

descriptions.zh: 我们已取得了诸多成就，但现在休息还为时尚早。只要能支配更多资源，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队就能在星系中部署得更远，守护更多被灵能所困扰的心灵。
descriptions.en: We have achieved much, but it is too soon to take rest. With more resources at our disposal, the fleets of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] could be deployed even further across the galaxy, protecting even greater numbers of minds plagued by psionics.

descriptions.zh: 帮助我们踏上旅程的正是您提供的启动资金，而我们的目标仍然是一样的：通过彻底根除灵能来促进心灵健康。有了您的帮助，我们离目标越来越近了。
descriptions.en: Your patronage has defined our journey from the very outset, and our shared goals remain the same: fostering mental wellbeing by the complete eradication of psionics. With your aid, we are inching ever closer to our goal.

descriptions.zh: 如果您认为值得再次投资我们的行动，我们就将成为星系中最大的反灵能军——群星间所有国家抵抗精神入侵的最高堡垒。
descriptions.en: If you see fit to invest in our operations once again, we could become the largest anti-psionic force in the galaxy - the supreme bastion against mind invasion for all nations among the stars.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 谢谢。很荣幸我们能与您合作，保护所有智慧生命的精神完整性。
descriptions.en: Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.

descriptions.zh:
一项伟大的事业。星系中灵督城邦的数量越多，所有人的灵魂就越不容易受到入侵。

我们可以就提高基础设施效率提供建议，以便建立、管理更多的城邦。
descriptions.en:
A fine undertaking. The more Mindwarden Enclaves there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.

We can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and administration of more enclaves.

tooltips.zh: 灵督城邦容量：§G+1§!
tooltips.en: Mindwarden Enclave Capacity: §G+1§!

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们很感谢您愿意分享这些研究成果。你传授给我们的所有知识都将有助于加强星系面对灵能威胁的保护。
descriptions.en: We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.

tooltips.zh: 我们将同这个太空城邦分享自己的§Y科技§!。只能每§Y10年§!进行一次。
tooltips.en: We will share our §Ytechnology§! with this enclave. This can only be done once every §Y10 years§!.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们很荣幸能肩挑重任。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队位于反灵能科技与战术的最前沿；任何试图入侵心灵的敌人都无法在他们面前立足。每支舰队都配备了一名专门接受过对抗灵能作战训练的指挥官。
descriptions.en: We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed with a commander specially trained in operations against psionic opponents.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们相信§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!在对付那些玩弄灵能毁灭性力量的家伙们时会是强有力的工具。
descriptions.en: We trust that the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.

descriptions.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
descriptions.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

options.script:
name = enclave.2060.a
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh: 确实。我们希望§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!令您如虎添翼。您打算终止或延长我们的协议吗？
descriptions.en: Certainly. We hope the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! has proven a valuable addition to your forces. Do you wish to terminate or prolong our contract?

label.en: We wish to extend our contract.
We wish to terminate our contract.

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes
close_mindwarden_diplomacy = yes

descriptions.zh: 很好。合约已终止，§H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!会立即返回。我们的舰队在您需要的时候永远等待您的雇佣。
descriptions.en: Very well. The contract is void and the §H[mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! will return to us immediately. Our fleets are available to hire whenever you require them.

descriptions.zh:
我们的思绪带着全新的目的在§H虚境§!中行动。当我们试着推进时，它也在将我们回推。起初，我们将此解读为对我们存在的抗拒，但如今我们明白了：虚境正在向我们发问。

尽管这些问题的含义依旧模糊，但它们并非无关紧要。据[GetTelepathPlural]所言，我们给出的答案将会影响社会的未来。
descriptions.en:
Our thoughts move through the §HShroud§! with newfound intent. As we push, it pushes back. At first, we interpreted this as resistance to our presence, but now we understand: the Shroud is asking questions of us.

Though hazy in meaning, these questions are not trivial. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the answers we give will influence the future of our society.

descriptions.zh:
我们与§H虚境§!的连结稳固；时刻准备着受到召唤。一段有节奏的乐句传信而来，这是虚境在对我们歌唱。

一副景象出现在我们[GetMindEyeLoc]之前。我们见到了§H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!。

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!
descriptions.en:
Our link to the §HShroud§! is strong; we are ready when it calls. The message comes in rhythmic phrases. The Shroud is singing to us.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see §H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!.

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!

descriptions.zh:
无形之物起起落落，呢喃声中，又一个意识破茧而出。

一副景象出现在我们[GetMindEyeLoc]之前。我们见到了§H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!。

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!
descriptions.en:
Something unseen shifts, and with a whisper another thought is birthed.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see §H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!.

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!

descriptions.zh:
无形之物起起落落，呢喃声中，又一个意识破茧而出。

一副景象出现在我们[GetMindEyeLoc]之前。我们见到了§H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!。

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!
descriptions.en:
Something unseen shifts, and with a whisper another thought is birthed.

An image forms in our [GetMindEyeLoc]. We see §H[GetRolledShroudSongName]§!.

§P[GetRolledShroudSongDesc]§!

descriptions.zh:
§H虚境§!陷入了沉寂，但一股灵能的重压笼罩在我们的社会之上。我们所给出的回应带来了新的机遇，只要我们愿意去追寻。

我们已升华的心灵正蓄势待发，准备迎接进一步的转化。那些用于承载心灵所需的物质载体，其重要性将大幅降低。

若我们继续沿着这条道路前行，人口将能超越对物质事务的关注，全身心地将部分存在投入到虚境之中。相比于精神敏锐度的提升，体力劳动能力的下降只是微不足道的代价。
descriptions.en:
The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended minds are primed for further transformation. The vessels that serve as support to the physical needs of the mind could become much less significant.

If we continue down this path, our population can transcend its concern with physical matters and commit itself fully to a partial existence inside of the Shroud. A reduced capacity for physical labor will be a small price for gains in mental acuity.

label.zh: 灵能飞升对集体而言是最优解。
label.en: Psionic transcendence is optimal for the collective.

tooltips.zh: 改变权力制度：[GetTranscendedAuthority]
tooltips.en: Changes Authority: [GetTranscendedAuthority]

descriptions.zh:
§H虚境§!陷入了沉寂，但一股灵能的重压笼罩在我们的社会之上。我们所给出的回应带来了新的机遇，只要我们愿意去追寻。

在这个物质维度中，我们升华后的形态蕴藏着巨大潜能。源源不断注入的灵能不断增强着我们的力量，并能将这股力量进一步传导至整个社会。

我们不仅会吟诵虚境的乐章，更会将其引入我们的[GetGovBehaviourLoc]之中。
descriptions.en:
The §HShroud§! grows silent, but a psychic weight has fallen upon our society. The answers we have given have offered new opportunities, should we choose to pursue them.

Our ascended forms hold great potential in this corporeal dimension. We continue to grow in strength from infusions of psionic energy, and can funnel this power further throughout our society.

We would not merely sing the songs of the Shroud, but channel them into our [GetGovBehaviourLoc].

label.en: Let the songs of the Shroud guide us.

tooltips.zh: 改变权力制度：[GetCorporealAuthority]
tooltips.en: Changes Authority: [GetCorporealAuthority]

descriptions.zh:
§H低语§!尖锐地变化着，祂们的声音覆盖了脑海中的一切。祂们渴望与我们交流，向我们灌输知识。

我们必须做出不可改变的选择。
descriptions.en:
The §HWhisperers§! shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.

We have an irrevocable choice to make.

descriptions.zh:
随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出§H虚境§!，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。

§H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!附近出现了一道虚境隧道，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。
descriptions.en:
As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the §HShroud§!, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].

A Shroud Tunnel has emerged near §H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!, which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

label.zh: 我们必须做好自卫的准备。
label.en: We must prepare to defend ourselves.

tooltips.zh:
§H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§!转变成了一颗§Y虚境星球§!。
该行星附近出现了一个虚境隧道。
tooltips.en:
§H[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]§! turns into a §YShrouded World§!.
A Shroud Tunnel appears near this planet.

descriptions.zh: 一个§Y灵能化身§!从[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]恒星系的虚境隧道上出现。这是[GetBetrayedPatronColour]之怒的显化，现在正向[capital_scope.GetName]袭来。
descriptions.en: A §YPsionic Avatar§! has emerged from the Shroud Tunnel in the [event_target:spawn_system.GetName] system. A manifestation of the wrath of [GetBetrayedPatronColour], it is now traveling in the direction of [capital_scope.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们成功地召集了力量反击出现的威胁。我们的舰船向虚境隧道中放出灵能能量波，在敌意实体穿入本现实时削弱了它。
descriptions.en: We were successful in gathering our forces against the emerging threat. Our ships emitted waves of psionic energy into the Shroud Tunnel, weakening the hostile entity as it breached into our reality.

tooltips.zh: 灵能化身以一半力量显现。
tooltips.en: Psionic Avatar emerges at half strength.

descriptions.zh:
一切转瞬即逝。

在我们国土内邪恶的§R终末光环§!突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。似乎我们抗击光环的努力起到了一些缓和作用，尽可能保留了一点。

究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。
descriptions.en:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent §RAura of the End§! present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead. It seems our efforts to repel the aura have had some mitigating effects, preserving what little we could.

Whatever madness invoked such destructive power may be forever unknown.

descriptions.zh:
一切转瞬即逝。

在我们国土内邪恶的§R终末光环§!突然消失了，将一切也随之带走。恒星坍缩成黑洞，行星原地蒸发，只剩下震耳欲聋的寂静。

究竟是什么疯子激起了这种毁灭性的力量也许永远不得而知了。
descriptions.en:
In an instant, it was all gone.

The malevolent §RAura of the End§! present in our systems has suddenly vanished, taking everything with it. Entire stars have collapsed into black holes, planets have disappeared, and a great silence has been left in their stead.

Whatever madness invoked such destructive power may be forever unknown.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[GetScientistPlural]完成了对称为§R最终清算§!的强大实体的全面研究。

基于目前发现，我们确定出了以现有科技面对该敌手的方法；用于击穿能量护盾的武器稍加改造即可用于削弱构成最终清算的能量。

尽管它非常强大，但我们现在面对该威胁时也不是毫无希望了。
descriptions.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have completed thorough research on the powerful entity known as the §RReckoning§!.

Based on their findings, we have determined an effective method of confronting this foe with our existing technology; the energy that comprises the Reckoning can be degraded using a modified form of weaponry designed to pierce energy shields.

Though it is formidable, we now stand a better chance of engaging this threat.

options.script:
name = shroud.11235.a
add_modifier = { modifier = reckoning_insight_modifier }

descriptions.zh:
§R最终清算§!拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。

初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
descriptions.en:
The §RReckoning§! is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.

Preliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.

descriptions.zh: 在研究被称为§R最终清算§!的实体的过程中我们的[GetScientistPlural]取得了突破。
descriptions.en: Our [GetScientistPlural] have made a breakthrough in their research concerning the energy being known as the §RReckoning§!.

descriptions.zh: 这个实体不仅是从§H虚境§!中显现而来，更通过与灵能界之间维持跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。使用具有“灵能抑制”性的一种激光，我们的舰队就能打破链接，从而能够直接攻击其物理形式。
descriptions.en: This entity not only emerged from the §HShroud§!, but maintains its defensive power via a transdimensional link to the psionic realm. Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.

descriptions.zh: 这个实体不仅是来自另一个维度，更通过维持神秘的跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。使用具有“灵能抑制”性的一种激光，我们的舰队就能打破链接，从而能够直接攻击其物理形式。
descriptions.en: This entity not only emerged from another dimension of reality, but maintains its defensive power via a mysterious transdimensional link. Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.

descriptions.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
descriptions.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

tooltips.zh: 离开虚境，返回普通空间。
tooltips.en: Leave the Shroud and return to normal space.

descriptions.zh: 自从§R轮回之终末§!带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。为此，我们在§H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§!系重建了一座§H哨站§!，这标志着[owner.GetName]的一个新的开始。
descriptions.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the §REnd of the Cycle§!. To this end, we have rebuilt an §HOutpost§! in the §H[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]§! system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
§H我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。§!

问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻魂灵之月窠的启示？
descriptions.en:
§HOur communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.§!

Greetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of the Cradle of Souls?

label.zh: 我们听到了魂灵之月窠的。你为什么这么问？
label.en: We have heard the Cradle of Souls. Why do you ask?

tooltips.en: §YGanthuata§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。§!

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

§H这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。§!

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于§H世界之喰煞§!。你也一样。
descriptions.en:
§HBattle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.§!

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

§HAs the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.§!

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the §HEater of Worlds§!. As do you.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_covenant_with_the_eater_of_worlds = yes }

tooltips.zh: §Y科博洛可-拉§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: §YKoborok'Ra§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H莫尔的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。§!

你也感受到了，对吧？渴求之器具永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。

我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。
descriptions.en:
§HMorr's gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.§!

You feel it too, don't you? The Instrument of Desire is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

label.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

tooltips.en: §YMorr§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同生命之织缕的低鸣。§!

新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日生命之织缕为我编织了何等形态？

§H通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。§!

你目睹了我的本相。或许我仍是受苦者克罗南，或许已非。但我能感知你，如我一般，是铺展在织缕之主笔下的画布。来吧。让我们开始揭幕。
descriptions.en:
§HAs our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of the Composer of Strands.§!

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has the Composer of Strands spun for me today?

§HThe comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.§!

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still Kronen the Afflicted. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

tooltips.zh: §Y受苦者克罗南§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: §YKronen the Afflicted§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H随着人群开始肿胀，受苦者克罗南变得愈发狂躁。他们的声音因紧绷而颤抖，形体抽搐、波动，血肉在剧变中翻腾，发出挫败的嘶吼。§!

那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？
descriptions.en:
§HAs our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.§!

The strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?

label.en: Can we do anything to help?
Can we do anything to help?

label.zh: 织缕之主的馈赠不可等闲视之。
label.en: A gift from the Composer should not be taken lightly.

descriptions.zh:
§H通讯阵列突然刺啦作响，一个声音带着诡异的紧迫感低语道。§!

向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？§H虚空之低语§!的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？

此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。
descriptions.en:
§HThe communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.§!

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of the §HWhisperers in the Void§!, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

label.zh: 为什么你觉得你可以帮得上忙？
label.en: What makes you think you can help?

tooltips.zh: §Y聆听者祖琳§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: §YZulyn the Listener§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。§!

终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
descriptions.en:
§HAn incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.§!

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.

descriptions.zh: §H我们这才意识到：与我们一样，这个存在也为最光辉的灭绝事业献出了自己的视力。§!
descriptions.en: §HIt is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.§!

descriptions.zh: §H这时我们才注意到，此人的眼窝空空如也，早已被摈弃。§!
descriptions.en: §HIt is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.§!

descriptions.zh: 得了吧，别害羞。我知道你已窥见§R轮回之终末§!那超凡的简洁。与我一同共鸣，我们将共同促使它显现。
descriptions.en: Come now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of the §REnd of the Cycle§!. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.

label.zh: 你知晓轮回之终末的存在有多久了？
label.en: How long have you known of the End of the Cycle?

tooltips.zh: §Y奥伏戎§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: §YOuw'ron§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，奥伏戎便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。§!

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入§H虚境§!之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
descriptions.en:
§HAll actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.§!

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the §HShroud§!.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

tooltips.zh: 奥伏戎向我们倒戈了！
tooltips.en: Ouw'ron is turning against us!

descriptions.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已通过一项议案，将我方列为军事目标。所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员如今都与[this.GetName]处于战争状态。我们必须准备好随时迎接他们的舰队进攻。
descriptions.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed a resolution declaring us a military target. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are now at war with the [this.GetName]. We can expect their fleets to strike at any moment.
